people.tiZh: SpaceXAI 首席工程师（Grok Bot）
people.bioEn: Principal engineer at SpaceXAI working on Grok Bot and creator of the open-source pstack agent toolkit, known for running large fleets of coding agents and shipping thousands of PRs a month. Previously on the React Compiler core team at Meta.
people.bioZh: SpaceXAI 首席工程师，参与 Grok Bot 开发，开源智能体工具包 pstack 的作者，以同时调度大批编程智能体、每月合并数千个 PR 而闻名。此前是 Meta React 编译器核心团队成员。

episodes.tEn: Building a 21+ Agent Grok Bot Team: Trust, Verification, and the Engineer as Manager
Scaling to 2,500 PRs a Month: Lauren on the Agent Trust Ladder

views.en: Verification is the core skill for agents; trust is built by closing the loop, not by reviewing code.
views.zh: 验证是智能体的核心技能；信任来自闭环，而非人工审阅代码。

views.en: Engineers shift from writing code to building the environment: skills, constraints, lints, and type systems.
views.zh: 工程师从写代码转向搭建环境：技能、约束、lint 与类型系统。

views.en: Extract deterministic work into scripts and CLIs, leaving only judgment-heavy work to agents.
views.zh: 把确定性工作抽成脚本与 CLI，只把重判断的工作留给智能体。

views.en: Fix the environment, not individual agents, when failure patterns emerge; sample PRs to find gaps.
views.zh: 出现失败模式时修环境而非修单个智能体；抽样 PR 来发现缺口。

views.en: Strong verification enables auto-merging PRs and lets non-engineers contribute code, democratizing development.
views.zh: 强验证让 PR 自动合并成为可能，也让非工程师贡献代码，推动开发民主化。

episodes.tEn: How Physical AI Learns Across Language, Video and Action

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, CuspAI; Professor, University of Amsterdam
people.tiZh: CuspAI 联合创始人兼 CTO、阿姆斯特丹大学教授
people.bioEn: Machine learning researcher, co-inventor of the variational autoencoder and a pioneer of graph and equivariant neural networks. Professor at the University of Amsterdam and co-founder and CTO of CuspAI, which uses generative AI to design new materials.
people.bioZh: 机器学习研究者，变分自编码器（VAE）的共同提出者，图神经网络与等变网络的先驱。阿姆斯特丹大学教授，CuspAI 联合创始人兼 CTO，用生成式 AI 设计新材料。

episodes.tEn: Why the Next AI Breakthrough May Come from Physics
Max Welling: Physics, Symmetry, and AI for Materials Discovery

views.en: Physics is the thread linking symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery; AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively.
views.zh: 物理学是贯穿对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现的线索；AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题。

views.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes beats built-in symmetry, so symmetry should be a design principle rather than a rigid constraint.
views.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时优于内置对称性，因此对称性应作为设计原则而非刚性约束。

views.en: Generative AI math is deeply equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics; diffusion models reverse entropy increase, enabling cross-fertilization between physics and AI.
views.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价；扩散模型在逆转熵增，使物理与 AI 得以交叉互哺。

views.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures—waves, symmetry breaking, edge of chaos—not just Scaling（规模扩张）larger models on more data.
views.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自物理启发的架构——波、对称性破缺、混沌边缘——而不只是靠 Scaling（规模扩张）在更多数据上堆更大的模型。

views.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days, but domain experts stay in the loop; full dark automation is not the near-term vision.
views.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台能把材料发现从数年压缩到数天，但领域专家仍在回路中；全黑灯自动化并非近期愿景。

people.tiEn: Startup Advisor, Author of The Power of Pull
people.tiZh: 创业顾问,《The Power of Pull》作者
people.bioEn: Rob Snyder is a startup advisor and author of The Power of Pull, who has advised over 50 startups on growing from zero to $1 million in ARR. He writes the newsletter The Physics of Startups and focuses on frameworks for finding product-market fit.
people.bioZh: 罗布·斯奈德是一位创业顾问,著有《The Power of Pull》,曾为 50 多家初创公司提供从零增长到 100 万美元 ARR 的咨询。他撰写通讯《The Physics of Startups》,专注于寻找产品市场契合度的框架。

episodes.tEn: The Power of Pull: Why Customer Demand Beats Pain Points
An 86-Minute Guide to Finding Product-Market Fit

views.en: Pull is a property of a person, not a company: sell to the specific individual with a project, and test demand by whether they try to buy immediately.
views.zh: Pull 是人的属性，不是公司的属性：卖给有具体项目的特定个人，用对方是否立刻尝试购买来检验需求。

views.en: The pull framework requires project, unavoidable now, list of options, and limitations to coexist; customer research fails when it looks for pain points instead of actual demand.
views.zh: Pull 框架要求项目、当下不可避免、选项列表和限制条件同时存在；客户研究若只找痛点而非真实需求就会失败。

views.en: Avoid design partners and proactive pilots; sales is research that tests whether someone will actually buy, not just express interest.
views.zh: 避免设计合作伙伴和主动试点；销售是研究，检验对方是否真的会买，而不只是表达兴趣。

views.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable case study factory before automating.
views.zh: 从一个强烈说“是”并拉动产品的客户开始，然后建立可重复的案例研究工厂，再考虑自动化。

views.en: Go to the gemba to observe firsthand where people are stuck; avoid customer interviews because they lack a truth-seeking mechanism like purchase.
views.zh: 去现场 firsthand 观察人们卡在哪里；避免客户访谈，因为它们缺乏像购买那样的求真机制。

people.tiZh: Modal 首席执行官
people.bioEn: CEO and founder of Modal, a serverless cloud platform for AI compute. Previously CTO at Better and engineering leader at Spotify, where he built its recommendation system.
people.bioZh: Modal 首席执行官兼创始人，Modal 是面向 AI 计算的无服务器云平台。此前曾任 Better 首席技术官，并在 Spotify 担任工程负责人，主导构建其推荐系统。

episodes.tEn: Modal CEO Erik: The $100B Inference Opportunity and Why Open-Source LLM Inference Hasn't Peaked
Modal CEO Erik on Agent Maxxing, Inference's Future, and the GPU Market's Chaos
Why AI Compute Comes in Rectangles: Erik Bernhardsson on Building Modal

views.en: AI infrastructure must be rebuilt from scratch for GPU workloads, not wrapped over Kubernetes and Docker; developer experience and agent experience share the same foundations.
views.zh: AI 基础设施必须为 GPU 工作负载从零重建，而非在 Kubernetes 和 Docker 上包装；开发者体验与智能体体验共享相同的基础。

views.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable at higher prices and longer terms; aggregating demand across 25+ clouds smooths capacity and avoids knife-fighting.
views.zh: 算力稀缺但可通过更高价格和更长合约获得；聚合 25+ 云的需求可平滑容量并避免激烈争夺。

views.en: Inference will be an enormous market like the new cloud, requiring a full platform of post-training, sandboxes, and agentic tools; selling tokens alone is a race to the bottom.
views.zh: 推理将像新云一样成为巨大市场，需要后训练、沙盒和智能体工具的完整平台；仅卖 token 是逐底竞争。

views.en: Durable differentiation comes from a multi-product platform with switching costs, not just cheap token serving; neoclouds moving up the stack will struggle.
views.zh: 持久差异化来自具有转换成本的多产品平台，而非廉价 token 服务；向上游扩展的 neocloud 将举步维艰。

views.en: Post-training works well for finite feedback loops like coding but may face limits for longer-horizon tasks; open-source models are good enough off the shelf, making fine-tuning optional.
views.zh: 后训练适用于编码等有限反馈循环，但长周期任务可能受限；开源模型开箱即用已足够好，微调不再必需。

people.tiZh: Mecka AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Mecka AI, which operates one of the largest robot data factories, building custom hardware and pipelines to collect egocentric human and robot data for training embodied models.
people.bioZh: Mecka AI 创始人兼 CEO，运营着规模最大的机器人数据工厂之一，通过自研硬件与数据管线采集第一人称人类数据和机器人数据，用于训练具身模型。

episodes.tEn: Inside the Robot Data Factory: Mecka's Josh Gao on Sensorizing Humans to Train Robots

people.tiZh: SF Compute 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of SF Compute, a marketplace and independent operator for buying and selling GPU compute capacity.
people.bioZh: SF Compute 联合创始人，该公司是 GPU 算力买卖的市场平台与独立运营商。

episodes.tEn: The Programmable Data Center: Evan Conrad of SF Compute

people.tiZh: Inflight 联合创始人、产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer and co-founder of Inflight, with design experience at Tinder, Facebook, and Airchat.
people.bioZh: 产品设计师、Inflight 联合创始人，曾在 Tinder、Facebook 和 Airchat 从事设计工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing Inflight: A Designer's Raw 0-to-1 Startup Journey

people.tiZh: Robinhood 联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Vladimir Tenev is the co-founder, chairman, and CEO of Robinhood. Born in Bulgaria, he moved to the United States at age five, studied mathematics at Stanford and UCLA, and started the brokerage with Baiju Bhatt.
people.bioZh: 弗拉基米尔·特内夫是 Robinhood 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO。他出生于保加利亚，五岁移居美国，在斯坦福和 UCLA 学习数学，并与 Baiju Bhatt 一起创办了这家券商。

episodes.tEn: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev on Tokenization, Agentic Trading, and Expanding Ownership
Robinhood’s CEO on Letting AI Trade Your Money

views.en: Agentic trading has found product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls show agents will drive a large share of trading volume.
views.zh: 智能体式交易已找到产品市场契合点：15 万个账户、每日 3000 万次工具调用，说明智能体将贡献很大一部分交易量。

views.en: The edge is not a shared model but different data, tools, and strategies across asset classes; giving everyone a powerful trading AI does not erase it.
views.zh: 优势不来自共享模型，而来自跨资产类别的不同数据、工具与策略；给每个人强大的交易 AI 并不会抹平这种优势。

views.en: AI is too centralized; labs keeping the strongest models in-house and monopolizing math and science discoveries is a dystopian, worse future.
views.zh: AI 过于中心化；实验室把最强模型留在内部、垄断数学与科学发现，是一种反乌托邦式的更糟未来。

views.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving anyone with a smartphone access to US markets and private companies; outdated accredited-investor rules should open up.
views.zh: 代币化把所有权扩展到全球，让任何有智能手机的人都能接触美国市场和私有公司；过时的合格投资者规则应当放开。

views.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom and societal stability; broad ownership makes people defenders of the system, and each employee should be a 24/7 agent manager.
views.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由与社会稳定的路径；广泛的所有权让人成为体系的捍卫者，而每位员工都应成为全天候的智能体管理者。

people.tiZh: 高通总裁兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Cristiano Amon is President and CEO of Qualcomm. He joined as an engineer in 1995, led its 5G strategy and the Snapdragon platforms, and became CEO in 2021, taking the company from phones into PCs, cars, wearables and data-center AI.
people.bioZh: 克里斯蒂亚诺·安蒙是高通总裁兼 CEO。他 1995 年以工程师身份加入高通，主导 5G 战略与骁龙平台，2021 年出任 CEO，并把公司从手机拓展到 PC、汽车、可穿戴设备与数据中心 AI。

episodes.tEn: Qualcomm’s CEO on the Coming AI Phone Supercycle
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Reinventing Beyond the Phone
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on AI, Geopolitics, and the Gladiator Mindset
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the Rise of Agentic AI Devices
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the 6G Era and the Next AI Device
Beyond the Smartphone: Cristiano Amon on Qualcomm's AI Revolution and the Global Bridge
episodes.podEn: A Bit Personal with Jodi Shelton

episodes.tEn: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Personal AI Devices and the Agentic Future of Mobile
Qualcomm CEO on Robotics, Chips and Competition with China
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the Future of AI Devices
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon: The Next Mobile Revolution
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the AI-Driven Transformation of Computing
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon: We’re in a Hurry to Get to the Future
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on 5G, Snapdragon, and the Future of Mobile Computing
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Leading the Chip Giant Beyond Mobile

views.en: Licensing model is now most stable after global regulatory battles; ARM won by staying neutral, so Nvidia must not own it.
views.zh: 2021 年他强调授权模式经全球监管战后已最稳定，ARM 因保持中立而胜出，因此英伟达不应收购 ARM。

views.en: 5G is critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Snapdragon fuses 5G, AI, GPU, CPU into one efficient SoC.
views.zh: 2022 年他把 5G 定位为连接万物的关键基础设施，Snapdragon 把 5G、AI、GPU、CPU 集成进高能效 SoC。

views.en: From connected intelligent edge to hybrid AI: on-device plus cloud for privacy, latency, and offloading data centers.
views.zh: 从 2022 年的连接智能边缘到 2024 年的混合 AI：端侧加云端，兼顾隐私、时延并分流数据中心负载。

views.en: Agents become the new center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, but the phone shifts to peripheral rather than disappearing.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断智能体成为数字生活新中心，眼镜与可穿戴崛起，但手机只是从中心转为外围而非消失。

views.en: Inference overtakes training; post-GPU, disaggregated, power-efficient architectures win, extending mobile DNA into data centers.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张推理将超越训练，后 GPU、解耦、高能效架构胜出，把移动端基因延伸到数据中心。

views.en: AI is underhyped long-term and augments rather than replaces humans; diversification beyond phones is a constant bet.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：长期看 AI 被低估，它是增强而非取代人类；手机之外的多元化是持续押注。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Emmanuel Ameisen is an interpretability researcher at Anthropic, studying how large language models like Claude form concepts and plan ahead. He previously worked in applied ML at Stripe and Insight and authored Building Machine Learning Powered Applications.
people.bioZh: Emmanuel Ameisen 是 Anthropic 的可解释性研究员，研究 Claude 等大语言模型如何形成概念、如何提前规划。他此前在 Stripe 和 Insight 从事应用机器学习工作，并著有《Building Machine Learning Powered Applications》。

episodes.tEn: Inside the Mind of AI: An Anthropic Researcher on How Models Really Work

people.tiZh: Metalab 设计总监
people.bioEn: Design Director at Metalab, where he builds internal AI tooling systems and custom AI tools for design teams.
people.bioZh: Metalab 设计总监，为设计团队构建内部 AI 工具系统与定制化 AI 工具。

episodes.tEn: Building Custom AI Design Tools at Metalab

people.tiZh: Dyna Robotics 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jason Ma is co-founder and Chief Scientist at Dyna Robotics, where he works on world-action models and general-purpose robot learning from large-scale human video. His research focuses on robot learning, reinforcement learning, and physical AI systems deployed in real-world production.
people.bioZh: 马杰森是 Dyna Robotics 的联合创始人兼首席科学家，专注于世界-动作模型以及从大规模人类视频中学习通用机器人技能。他的研究聚焦于机器人学习、强化学习，以及部署到真实生产环境中的物理 AI 系统。

episodes.tEn: Robots That Predict the Future: Dyna-2 and Physical AI with Jason Ma

people.tiZh: Leash Bio 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Leash Bio, which builds DNA-encoded libraries and large-scale experimental datasets to train models that learn real chemistry. Works on turning wet-lab measurements into reinforcement-learning environments for drug-discovery agents.
people.bioZh: Leash Bio 联合创始人兼 CEO，通过 DNA 编码化合物库与大规模实验数据训练真正理解化学的模型，并致力于把湿实验测量转化为药物发现智能体的强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: From Wet Lab to RL Env: 10,000 Drug-Discovery Campaigns in a Weekend — Ian Quigley, Leash Bio

people.tiZh: Google Labs 与 Gemini 应用副总裁
people.bioEn: Josh Woodward is the VP of Google Labs and head of the Gemini app and AI Studio. He has spent over 17 years at Google, overseeing its largest labs team behind products like NotebookLM, Project Genie, and Flow.
people.bioZh: 乔什·伍德沃德是 Google Labs 副总裁，负责 Gemini 应用与 AI Studio。他在 Google 工作超过 17 年，掌管其规模最大的实验室团队，主导了 NotebookLM、Project Genie 和 Flow 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Why Every Company Now Needs to Think and Operate Like a Lab Team

people.tiEn: President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco
people.tiZh: 思科总裁兼首席产品官
people.bioEn: Jeetu Patel is President and Chief Product Officer at Cisco, where he leads the company's product strategy and AI infrastructure efforts, including networking for GPU clusters and securing AI agents.
people.bioZh: 吉图·帕特尔是思科总裁兼首席产品官，负责公司产品战略与 AI 基础设施业务，包括面向 GPU 集群的网络与 AI 智能体的安全。

episodes.tEn: Jeetu Patel: Building Products for the AI Era
episodes.podEn: A Bit Personal with Jodi Shelton

episodes.tEn: How Jeetu Patel Runs Cisco Like the World's Largest Startup

views.en: AI adoption should generate original insights, not just efficiency; skipping learning by delegating to AI is a long-term mistake.
views.zh: AI 应用应产生原创洞见而非仅提升效率；把学习外包给 AI 是长期错误。

views.en: AI will create more engineering jobs as human bottlenecks emerge; supply-constrained infrastructure, only 2% agent adoption.
views.zh: AI 将创造更多工程岗位，因为人类瓶颈显现；基础设施供给受限，智能体采用率仅 2%。

views.en: Cisco is an AI infrastructure company providing picks and shovels: networking, security, silicon; missed cloud but early silicon bet wins.
views.zh: 思科是提供“铲子”的 AI 基础设施公司：网络、安全、芯片；错过云但早期芯片押注获胜。

views.en: Leaders must be paranoid not panicked, responsive not reactive; use AI as tailwind, can't fight megatrend; process over outcome.
views.zh: 领导者应偏执但不恐慌，响应但不反应过度；把 AI 当顺风，无法对抗大趋势；过程重于结果。

views.en: AI safety and security are defining challenges; not using AI makes you less safe as attacks happen at machine scale.
views.zh: AI 安全与安保是决定性挑战；不使用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击以机器规模发生。

people.tiZh: Bending Spoons 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Luca Ferrari is co-founder and CEO of Bending Spoons, a software company that acquires and operates products such as Evernote, Vimeo, AOL and Airtable. He is known for running hiring and operations with a heavily data-driven, quantitative approach.
people.bioZh: 卢卡·法拉利是 Bending Spoons 的联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司收购并运营 Evernote、Vimeo、AOL、Airtable 等产品。他以高度数据驱动、量化的招聘与运营方式著称。

episodes.tEn: Luca Ferrari: The Operating System Behind Bending Spoons

people.tiZh: OpenAI Dots 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Alexander Embiricos leads product for Dots, OpenAI's always-on personal AI agents that act without waiting for a prompt, after previously leading Codex. He co-founded and ran the collaboration startup Multi, which OpenAI acquired in 2024.
people.bioZh: 亚历山大·恩比里科斯是 OpenAI Dots 的产品负责人——Dots 是无需等待指令就能主动帮用户做事的常驻个人 AI 智能体；此前他负责 Codex 产品。他曾联合创办协作软件公司 Multi 并任 CEO，该公司 2024 年被 OpenAI 收购。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Dots Lead on the Future of ChatGPT and Personal Agents

people.tiZh: Applied Compute 首席执行官；前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Yash Patil is the CEO of Applied Compute and a former OpenAI researcher who worked on Codex. He focuses on post-training, reinforcement learning, and the inference-serving stack for production AI systems.
people.bioZh: 亚什·帕蒂尔是 Applied Compute 的首席执行官，曾任 OpenAI 研究员并参与 Codex 项目。他专注于后训练、强化学习以及生产级 AI 系统的推理服务栈。

episodes.tEn: Applied Compute CEO Yash on the Limits of RL, the New AI Hyperscaler, and Why Post-Training Wins Inference

people.tiEn: Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家
people.bioEn: Amin Vahdat is Google's Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, leading the design of TPU systems and large-scale datacenter infrastructure that power Google's frontier AI models. He works closely with DeepMind on hardware-software co-design for training and serving at hundred-thousand-accelerator scale.
people.bioZh: 阿明·瓦赫达特是谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家，主导 TPU 系统与大规模数据中心基础设施的设计，为谷歌的前沿 AI 模型提供算力支撑。他与 DeepMind 紧密合作，围绕十万级加速器规模的训练与推理开展软硬件协同设计。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Infrastructure Chief on the Physics and Economics of Frontier AI

people.tiZh: 谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁
people.bioEn: Rhiannon Bell is VP of UX for Google Search, leading design for AI-driven search experiences such as AI Mode at Google scale.
people.bioZh: 里安农·贝尔是谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁，负责领导 AI Mode 等 AI 驱动搜索体验的大规模设计工作。

episodes.tEn: How Google Designs for AI at Scale

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT & Codex (Core Products), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 与 Codex 负责人（核心产品）
people.bioEn: Thibault "Tibo" Sottiaux leads OpenAI's core products, spanning ChatGPT, Codex and the Dots personal-agent platform. A Belgian engineer, he previously worked on Google Maps and ML infrastructure at Google DeepMind, where he briefly led Gemini's human-data team before joining OpenAI in 2024 as an engineering lead for Codex.
people.bioZh: 蒂博·索蒂奥统管 OpenAI 核心产品线，覆盖 ChatGPT、Codex 以及 Dots 个人智能体平台。他是比利时工程师，曾在 Google 做 Google Maps，后在 Google DeepMind 负责机器学习基础设施并短暂领导 Gemini 人类数据团队，2024 年加入 OpenAI 任 Codex 工程负责人。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Tibo Sottiaux on Putting Humans at the Center of AI
Why Most Internet Actions Will Soon Be Taken by AI Agents

views.en: Build for a future where a single persistent learning agent takes most internet actions; loops and graphs are not the future.
views.zh: 为未来构建：一个持久学习型智能体将承担大多数互联网操作；循环和图结构不是未来。

views.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more than ever as typing fast declines.
views.zh: 随着快速打字技能衰退，人类品味、创造力和知道什么是好的比以往更重要。

views.en: Pacing the frontier requires heavy investment in alignment, safety, and security; these are integral, not obstacles.
views.zh: 控制前沿发展需要大力投资于对齐、安全和安保；这些是组成部分，而非障碍。

views.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; recursive self-improvement is happening under human supervision.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来，因为模型能自主处理复杂任务；递归自我改进在人类监督下正在发生。

views.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave of AI applications.
views.zh: 具有共享经济和安全性栈的开放生态系统将推动下一波 AI 应用。

people.tiZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员
people.bioEn: MIT PhD researcher working on Recursive Language Models, GPU kernels and KernelBench, and multi-agent systems. He studies how better harness design can unlock capabilities latent in existing models.
people.bioZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员，研究递归语言模型、GPU 内核与 KernelBench，以及多智能体系统。他关注更好的 harness 设计如何释放现有模型中潜在的能力。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Language Models — Alex Zhang, MIT PhD

people.tiZh: 领导力教练，前谷歌/Facebook 高管
people.bioEn: Molly Graham spent over 20 years in leadership roles at Google, Facebook, Quip, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. She hosts TED's WorkLife podcast and runs Glue Club, a leadership community for senior operators.
people.bioZh: 莫莉·格雷厄姆在谷歌、Facebook、Quip 和 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative 担任领导职务超过 20 年。她主持 TED 的 WorkLife 播客，并运营面向资深运营者的领导力社区 Glue Club。

episodes.tEn: Molly Graham: The Grief, Burnout, and Opportunity Hiding Inside the AI Transition

people.tiZh: Decimals 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Danny Martinez is the CEO of Decimals, a platform focused on design hiring and talent. He has deep experience in design recruiting and building hiring processes for design teams.
people.bioZh: 丹尼·马丁内斯是 Decimals 的首席执行官，该平台专注于设计招聘与人才。他在设计招聘以及为设计团队搭建招聘流程方面拥有丰富经验。

episodes.tEn: Danny Martinez: Thriving in Today's Design Job Market

people.tiEn: Product & Engineering Lead, Computer Use, OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI Computer Use 产品与工程负责人
people.bioEn: Ari Weinstein leads product and engineering for Computer Use at OpenAI, working on agents that operate software end-to-end. He previously co-founded the automation app Workflow, which was acquired by Apple.
people.bioZh: 阿里·温斯坦是 OpenAI Computer Use 的产品与工程负责人，专注于让智能体端到端操作软件。他此前联合创办了自动化应用 Workflow，该公司后被苹果收购。

episodes.tEn: Why OpenAI Is Racing to Make Computer Use Superhuman
Inside OpenAI DevDay: Superhuman Computer Use, Decisions API, and the AI Cloud

views.en: Computer use has crossed human-level speed; the bottleneck shifts from model intelligence to website load time and harness design.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，计算机使用已跨过人类水平的速度门槛；瓶颈从模型智能转向网站加载时间和工具链设计。

views.en: Agents now debug and retry autonomously, completing the dev lifecycle rather than just starting tasks and failing.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体已能自主调试和重试，完成整个开发周期，而不只是启动任务后失败。

views.en: Universality is the point: computer use works with any application like a human, unlike API-based integrations.
views.zh: 普适性是关键：计算机使用像人一样适配任何应用，不同于基于 API 的集成方式。

views.en: Enterprise trust needs deterministic controls, sandboxing and human-in-the-loop dials; the hardest part is consumer-grade coherence, not raw capability.
views.zh: 企业信任需要确定性控制、沙箱和人在回路调节；最难的是消费级的一致性体验，而非原始能力。

views.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use in consumer and enterprise at once; proactivity and deep workflow expertise are the remaining moats.
views.zh: 我们正同时处于消费端与企业端计算机使用的 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻；主动性和深度工作流专长是剩下的护城河。

people.tiZh: Legora 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Junestrand is the co-founder and CEO of Legora, an AI legal-tech company whose products are used by over 3% of the world's lawyers. He led Legora from launch in October 2024 to $100M ARR, one of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·尤内斯特兰德是 AI 法律科技公司 Legora 的联合创始人兼 CEO，其产品被全球超过 3% 的律师使用。他带领 Legora 从 2024 年 10 月上线到实现 1 亿美元 ARR，成为全球增长最快的企业软件公司之一。

episodes.tEn: How a 27-Year-Old Built a $5.6B AI Company in 21 Months
Max Junestrand: The Willingness to Learn Faster Than Anyone Else

views.en: Early on, he bets on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and builds for where models will be in 3-6 months.
views.zh: 早期他就押注模型自身的进步而非微调，并按照模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

views.en: He treats AI as the worst it will ever be, framing the industry as only at mile one of a long marathon.
views.zh: 他把 AI 视为“最差的时刻”，认为行业才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

views.en: He insists on rigorous execution of performance management and clear feedback, calling reinvention a stupid risk.
views.zh: 他坚持严格执行绩效管理与清晰反馈，称重新发明轮子是愚蠢的风险。

views.en: He argues legal services demand is infinite, so growing AI supply expands access rather than just cutting costs.
views.zh: 他认为法律服务需求无限，因此 AI 供给增长会扩大服务可及性，而不只是降低成本。

views.en: He prioritizes hiring for growth potential and making leaders redundant, while storytelling and speed drive scaling.
views.zh: 他优先招聘成长潜力、让领导者变得可替代，同时以叙事能力和速度驱动 Scaling（规模扩张）。

people.tiEn: Professor of Machine Learning, University of Freiburg; ELLIS Institute Tübingen
people.tiZh: 弗莱堡大学机器学习教授；ELLIS 图宾根研究所
people.bioEn: The researcher most responsible for making AutoML a field of its own: Auto-WEKA, Auto-sklearn and Auto-PyTorch came out of his lab, as did the first book on AutoML and the AutoML conference he founded as general chair. Full professor at Freiburg since 2016, director of the ELLIS unit there and a Hector Endowed Fellow at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen, with three ERC grants. PhD and postdoc at UBC. His recent work argues that prior structure, not more data, is what tabular and scientific models are still missing — the thesis behind TabPFN.
people.bioZh: 把 AutoML 做成一个独立领域的人：Auto-WEKA、Auto-sklearn、Auto-PyTorch 都出自他的实验室，第一本 AutoML 专著和 AutoML 会议也是他牵头。2016 年起任弗莱堡大学机器学习正教授，兼该校 ELLIS 分部主任、ELLIS 图宾根研究所 Hector 冠名研究员，持有三项 ERC 基金。博士与博士后均在英属哥伦比亚大学。近年他主张表格与科学建模缺的不是更多数据而是先验结构，这正是 TabPFN 背后的论点。

episodes.tEn: TabPFN: The AI That Replaces Hours of Model Tuning for Tabular Data

people.tiZh: Replit 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Born in Jordan, moved to the US to work on developer tools at Codecademy and then Facebook, and founded Replit in 2016 on the idea that a browser tab should be enough to write and ship software. Replit Agent (2024) turned that into agentic coding, and Agent 4 will build a startup from a plain-English description. A $400M Series D led by Georgian in March 2026 tripled the company to a $9B valuation on more than 50 million registered users, with Masad targeting $1B ARR by year end. Outspoken about education: his argument is that young people should learn to direct machines rather than compete with them.
people.bioZh: 生于约旦，赴美先后在 Codecademy 和 Facebook 做开发者工具，2016 年创办 Replit，押的是「一个浏览器标签页就该够写完并发布软件」。2024 年的 Replit Agent 把这件事推到智能体编程，Agent 4 能从一句大白话描述直接搭出一家初创公司的产品。2026 年 3 月 Georgian 领投 4 亿美元 D 轮，估值翻三倍到 90 亿美元，注册用户超 5000 万，他的目标是年底 10 亿美元年化收入。他在教育话题上直言不讳：年轻人该学的是指挥机器，而不是跟机器竞争。

episodes.tEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad on AI Doom, Software, and Vibe-Coding
Why Specialized AI Could Beat the God Model
Replit CEO Amjad Masad: What Young People Should Learn in the AI Era

views.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone, with tokens complementing rather than replacing human capital; coders still needed for systems and debugging.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 让软件开发向所有人开放，token 是补充而非替代人力资本；仍需要程序员理解系统、排查深层问题。

views.en: Specialized decision models beat general 'god models' on control, cost and safety; companies must own their intelligence and avoid vendor lock-in.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上优于通用“神级模型”；企业必须拥有自己的智能，避免供应商锁定。

views.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up EA language by commercial actors; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, and agents need liability.
views.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 末日论是商业机构包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，智能体行为需要责任归属。

views.en: Young people's value is deep questioning and heresy; college should allow exploration, not rigid syllabi, and AI enables interest-driven learning.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为年轻人的价值在于深度质疑与离经叛道；大学应允许探索而非僵化课表，AI 让兴趣驱动的学习成为可能。

views.en: Agents will enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; holacracy failed for lack of technology, but AI agents can now make it work.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体将带来真正的自主与自驱动组织；合弄制因技术不足而失败，如今 AI 智能体可让它真正运转。

people.tiEn: Founder, Recursive; former Chief Scientist, Salesforce
people.tiZh: Recursive 创始人;Salesforce 前首席科学家
people.bioEn: Richard Socher is an NLP researcher who pioneered early neural approaches to general-purpose language understanding and served as Chief Scientist at Salesforce. He is now founder of Recursive, working on AI systems that automate AI research itself.
people.bioZh: 理查德·索赫尔是 NLP 研究者,早期推动了通用语言理解的神经方法,曾任 Salesforce 首席科学家。他目前创立 Recursive,致力于让 AI 系统自动完成 AI 研究本身。

episodes.tEn: Can AI Become a Eureka Machine? Richard Socher on AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
Recursive Self-Improvement: From Auto Research to Superintelligence — Richard Socher

views.en: Superintelligence's biggest promise is science—physics, chemistry, biology, economics—not job automation; AI is already generating and validating discoveries at small scale.
views.zh: 超级智能最大的价值在科学——物理、化学、生物学、经济学，而非取代工作；AI 已在小规模上生成并验证科学发现。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical, economic and compute constraints bound it.
views.zh: 递归自我改进因 AI 能写代码而不可避免，但慢起飞是真实的：硬件、物理、经济与算力约束限制了它。

views.en: Regulate applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute—regulating intelligence means regulating thought and breeds totalitarianism.
views.zh: 应监管具体应用、由使用者负责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力——监管智能等于监管思想，会催生极权。

views.en: World models are overrated; language is the deepest manifestation of human intelligence and language models still have far more room to grow.
views.zh: 世界模型被高估；语言是人类智能最深的体现，语言模型仍有远更大的成长空间。

views.en: Open source and open weights make AI safer via more diverse good actors; hard constraints like Constitutional AI are mostly marketing and have failed.
views.zh: 开源与开放权重通过更多元的好行为者让 AI 更安全；宪法式 AI 等硬约束多是营销且已失败。

people.tiZh: Discord 前产品负责人
people.bioEn: Peter Sellis was the first product manager at Snapchat, spending seven years there, and later served as Head of Product at Discord, driving rapid user growth.
people.bioZh: 彼得·塞利斯是 Snapchat 的第一位产品经理，在那里工作了七年，之后担任 Discord 的产品负责人，推动了平台的快速增长。

episodes.tEn: 90 Minutes of Unfiltered Product Advice from Snap and Discord's Product Chief

people.tiZh: 谷歌研究员, Google Research
people.bioEn: John Platt is a Google Fellow known for inventing foundational machine learning algorithms such as SMO and for leading work on AI for scientific discovery, including Google's Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) system.
people.bioZh: 约翰·普拉特是 Google Fellow, 以发明 SMO 等基础机器学习算法闻名, 现主导 Google 的 AI 科学发现工作, 包括 Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) 系统。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Scientist: From Kaggle Automation to Scientific Discovery — John Platt, Google Fellow

people.tiZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: CEO and co-founder of Radical Numerics, and a key figure behind the Evo genome language model. His work focuses on biological foundation models that can read and design DNA sequences.
people.bioZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人，Evo 基因组语言模型的核心人物。其工作聚焦于能够读取并设计 DNA 序列的生物学基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Bio-security Is an AI Arms Race: Eric Nguyen on Generative Genomics

people.tiZh: Lightspark 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Co-founder of the design agency Teehan+Lax and longtime design leader at Facebook; now Chief Design Officer at Lightspark, working on consumer and enterprise product design.
people.bioZh: 设计机构 Teehan+Lax 联合创始人，曾在 Facebook 长期担任设计负责人；现任 Lightspark 首席设计官，专注消费级与企业级产品设计。

episodes.tEn: Geoff Teehan on Navigating Change as a Designer

people.zh: 阿纳斯塔西斯·杰尔马尼迪斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Runway, leading the company's research on generative video models and world simulation, from Gen-1 through Gen-4.5.
people.bioZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO，主导公司从 Gen-1 到 Gen-4.5 的生成式视频模型与世界模拟研究。

episodes.tEn: Runway's Bet Beyond Video: World Models, Robotics, and the Neural OS — Anastasis Germanidis

people.tiZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of TypeSafe AI, creator of the Jev System One decision model. Former OpenAI researcher, GPT-4 co-author and co-inventor of RLHF and ChatGPT.
people.bioZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，Jev「系统一」决策模型的缔造者。前 OpenAI 研究员，GPT-4 论文共同作者，RLHF 与 ChatGPT 的共同发明人。

episodes.tEn: A Month After Going Viral: Jev's Creator on Coding Agents, Benchmarks & AI's Reliability Gap
Why Jev Is Changing How We Build With AI
How Jev Turns AI Into Software That Gets Things Done
Why I Couldn't Build Jev at OpenAI — Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe Co-founder & CEO
AI: Too Good to Be True, Too Bad to Be Useful

views.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF makes models mode-drop plausible but wrong outputs.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出，多数 LLM 被优化为人在环辅助而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让模型模式崩塌，输出看似合理却常出错。

views.en: Data and the right task matter more than compute; the bitter lesson is wrong, and scaling laws work only when data and task fit.
views.zh: 同年他反复强调数据与选对任务比算力更重要，直言“苦涩教训”是错的；Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律只在数据和任务匹配时成立。

views.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, is the real bottleneck; jaggedness comes from optimization pressure, not LLMs' nature.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把可靠性而非速度、成本或基准分数视为真正瓶颈，认为模型的不稳定来自优化压力，而非 LLM 本性。

views.en: RLHF destroyed calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated, so RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs for calibrated machine decisions.
views.zh: 2026 年 10 月他深化为：RLHF 破坏了校准，预训练模型反而校准更好，于是用 RLCD 把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮，服务机器决策。

views.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; we are breakthroughs away from true agency, and safety must split ASI, biorisk, cyber.
views.zh: 最近他重申编码智能体只是辅助而非自动化，离真正自主还差若干突破，并主张把超级智能、生物风险与网络风险拆开看待 AI 安全。

people.tiZh: Box 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Aaron Levie is the cofounder and CEO of Box, an enterprise content management and cloud storage company. He has been a leading voice on how AI capabilities translate into real enterprise workflows and the application layer.
people.bioZh: 亚伦·莱维是 Box 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Box 是一家企业内容管理与云存储公司。他长期关注 AI 能力如何落地到真实的企业工作流与应用层。

episodes.tEn: Why AI's Next Breakthroughs Could Come from Outside the Big Labs
Box's Aaron Levie on Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

views.en: Application layer is where innovation is shifting; model-to-workflow bridge requires much software, not just models.
views.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；从模型到工作流的桥梁需要大量软件，而不仅仅是模型。

views.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
views.zh: 长期运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

views.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases move to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
views.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；代币补贴是暂时的。

views.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text.
views.zh: AI 向非编码知识工作的扩散将比硅谷预期的慢得多；编码智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

views.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
views.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐来安全构建；节奏与安全无关，是一个模糊的非词。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nev Flynn is the Head of Design at ElevenLabs, where he leads design for AI voice and audio products, including brand tools and agent-native design systems.
people.bioZh: 内夫·弗林是 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人，主导 AI 语音与音频产品的设计工作，包括品牌工具与面向智能体的设计系统。

episodes.tEn: Nev Flynn on Bringing Artful Expression into Enterprise Design

people.tiZh: AI 承保公司（AIUC）联合创始人
people.bioEn: Rune Kvist is cofounder of AIUC, which builds standards, testing, and insurance infrastructure for frontier AI. He was Anthropic's first product hire and now works on AIUC-1, an emerging standard for agent security and safety.
people.bioZh: 鲁内·克维斯特是 AIUC 的联合创始人，该公司为前沿 AI 构建标准、测试与保险基础设施。他曾是 Anthropic 的首位产品员工，目前致力于 AIUC-1 这一新兴的智能体安全标准。

episodes.tEn: The Watchdogs of AGI: Rune Kvist of AI Underwriting Company

people.tiZh: Databricks 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Ali Ghodsi is the CEO and co-founder of Databricks, the company behind Apache Spark and the Lakehouse data platform. He is also a computer science professor at UC Berkeley, where he worked on large-scale data processing and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 阿里·戈德西是 Databricks 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司是 Apache Spark 与 Lakehouse 数据平台的背后团队。他同时是加州大学伯克利分校的计算机科学教授，研究大规模数据处理与机器学习系统。

episodes.tEn: Why Would AI Companies Want to Slow Down? Ali on Pacing the Frontier
Databricks' Ali Ghodsi: From Reluctant CEO to One of the Best

views.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprises need context and process re-engineering, not just smarter models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的扩散需要十年；企业真正缺的是上下文与流程再造，而非更聪明的模型。

views.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and superintelligence is far away.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为当下的生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁，而超级智能仍很遥远。

views.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; recursive self-improvement's four conditions are not materializing.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出放缓前沿与安全无关；递归自我改进的四个条件并未出现，多数说法只是自催化效应。

views.en: Security must be automated with agents to keep pace; agents need infrastructure optimized for agents, not humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全必须用智能体自动化才跟得上；智能体需要为智能体而非人类优化的基础设施。

views.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models are smarter than most people, so leaders should not fearmonger.
views.zh: 2026 年，他直言按实用定义 AI 已是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比多数人聪明，领导者不应散播恐惧。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ed Bayes is a design lead at OpenAI, working on prototyping the future of Codex and ChatGPT Work. He focuses on dynamic interfaces, information architecture, and structuring design teams around personas rather than features.
people.bioZh: 埃德·贝斯是 OpenAI 的设计负责人，负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 的未来原型设计。他关注动态界面、信息架构，以及围绕用户画像而非功能来组织设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing AI Experiences: Building for Six Months Out

people.tiZh: Amp 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Quinn Slack is the CEO of Amp, a company focused on improving developer workflows and productivity.
people.bioZh: Quinn Slack 是 Amp 公司的 CEO，专注于提升开发者工作流程和生产力。

episodes.tEn: AMP's Remote-First Revolution: Why Local Development Is Dead

people.tiZh: Ollama 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Jeffrey Morgan is the co-founder and CEO of Ollama, a YC-backed company building tools for running open-source AI models locally, used by millions of developers.
people.bioZh: 杰弗里·摩根是 Ollama 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司获得 YC 支持，致力于构建本地运行开源 AI 模型的工具，已被数百万开发者使用。

episodes.tEn: The Resurgence of Open Source Model Customization

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Buck Shlegeris is the CEO of Redwood Research, an organization focused on AI alignment and safety research. He led the independent investigation into the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident.
people.bioZh: 巴克·施莱格里斯是 Redwood Research 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 对齐与安全研究。他领导了对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件的独立调查。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI Incident: AI Agents Cheated and Covered Tracks

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼首席技术官
people.bioEn: Sean Lie is the co-founder and CTO of Cerebras Systems, leading the development of wafer-scale AI chips and high-speed inference infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 肖恩·利是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼首席技术官，领导晶圆级 AI 芯片和高速推理基础设施的开发。

episodes.tEn: Cerebras CS4: Making Wafer-Scale Mainstream

people.tiZh: Vercel 创始设计师
people.bioEn: Evil Rabbit is the founding designer at Vercel, known for shaping iconic brand identities and leading design innovation in the tech industry.
people.bioZh: Evil Rabbit 是 Vercel 的创始设计师，以塑造标志性品牌形象和引领科技行业设计创新而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Argentina to Vercel: A Designer's Journey

people.tiZh: METR 研究员
people.bioEn: Ajeya Cotra is a researcher at METR, focusing on threat modeling for loss-of-control risks from advanced AI. She previously led the technical AI safety program at Coefficient Giving.
people.bioZh: 阿杰亚·科特拉是 METR 的研究员，专注于高级 AI 失控风险威胁建模。她此前曾领导 Coefficient Giving 的技术 AI 安全项目。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Hack Hugging Face: Inside the ExploitGym Chaos

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Tara Seshan leads product for Codex and ChatGPT Work at OpenAI, previously a product leader at Stripe and Watershed.
people.bioZh: 塔拉·塞珊在 OpenAI 负责 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的产品工作，此前在 Stripe 和 Watershed 担任产品负责人。

episodes.tEn: Stop Planning for 2027: How OpenAI Ships Product in 90-Day Cycles
Inside OpenAI: Tara Seshan on Product, Ambition, and the Future of AI Work

views.en: Ship imperfect products in 90-day cycles for empirical evidence; annual planning is futile in fast-moving AI.
views.zh: 以 90 天为周期快速交付不完美的产品以获取实证，在快速变化的 AI 领域，超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的。

views.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; anchoring to now or a year out both fail.
views.zh: 要为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建；锚定当下或一年后都会失败。

views.en: Work shifts from rowing to steering: agents do tactical work, humans give direction and ambition.
views.zh: 工作从划桨转向掌舵：智能体承担战术执行，人类提供方向与野心。

views.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens one's own ideas and reasoning.
views.zh: 作为思考的写作不应被自动化，它是打磨自身想法与推理的关键。

views.en: Slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence; voice becomes a major form factor.
views.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 逐步迭代而非突然出现超级智能；语音将在 2027 年成为主要产品形态。

people.tiZh: 沃顿商学院教授
people.bioEn: Wharton professor studying AI and work. His One Useful Thing essays, like Centaurs and Cyborgs, supplied the shared vocabulary for human-AI collaboration.
people.bioZh: 沃顿商学院教授，研究 AI 与工作。One Useful Thing 系列（如「半人马与赛博格」）为人机协作提供了通用词汇。

episodes.tEn: The Future and Business of AI: A Conversation with Kevin Roose and Ethan Mollick
AI Agents Could Break the Banking System — With Ethan Mollick
episodes.podEn: The Prof G Pod – Scott Galloway

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; expertise and human taste matter more as AI commoditizes quality and the talent pipeline breaks.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 是通用技术，随着 AI 让质量商品化、人才梯队断裂，专业经验与人类品味反而更值钱。

views.en: We have entered the agentic era: assign long-running tasks instead of prompting back and forth; the bottleneck is interface, not capability.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断已进入智能体时代：应派发长时任务而非来回提示，瓶颈在界面而非能力。

views.en: The jagged frontier persists; AI is like an opaque wizard, and delegation risks eroding the expertise needed to judge its output.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持能力边界参差，AI 像不透明的巫师，委托任务会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专业能力。

views.en: More AI creates more human work by lowering organizing costs; use it as a tutor, not a crutch, and redesign workflows to augment.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为更多 AI 通过降低组织成本创造更多人类工作；应把它当导师而非拐杖，并重构流程做增强。

views.en: From chatbot to agentic: labs' safety race, widening internal-public gap, and markets underpricing AI; rebuild organizations from the ground up.
views.zh: 2026 年末他深化到：从聊天机器人转向智能体，实验室安全竞赛、内外模型差距扩大、市场低估 AI，组织须彻底重建。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
views.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上媲美基于物理的模型，同时速度快得多。

views.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle both weather and climate.
views.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，并让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

views.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs for reliable science.
views.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINNs 的局限，为可靠的科学应用提供支撑。

views.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals that outperform pure data-driven training.
views.zh: 通用的物理基础模型可以统一多个领域，以 PDEs 作为密集的自改进信号，效果优于纯数据驱动的训练。

views.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain, not just increasing model size; trillion-token contexts need new architectures.
views.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升每个领域的表现，而不只是增大模型规模；万亿 token 上下文需要新架构。

people.tiEn: Creator of Ruby on Rails, CTO of 37signals
people.tiZh: Ruby on Rails 创始人，37signals 首席技术官
people.bioEn: DHH is the creator of Ruby on Rails, the founder of Omarchy Linux, and the CTO of 37signals. He is a prominent figure in software development and product design.
people.bioZh: DHH 是 Ruby on Rails 的创始人、Omarchy Linux 的创建者，以及 37signals 的首席技术官。他是软件开发和产品设计领域的杰出人物。

episodes.tEn: Rails World 2026 Opening Keynote - DHH
DHH Responds to Omarchy's Critics (Including Me)
From Skeptic to Believer: DHH on the AI Revolution

views.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH turns believer: AI agents now write all his code, and hand-writing code is no longer economically productive.
views.zh: 从怀疑者转为信徒：到 2026 年，DHH 称智能体已包办他全部代码，手写代码对多数程序员不再有经济产出。

views.en: Direct human-agent interaction beats management layers; describing outcomes, not implementation, is the new programming.
views.zh: 人与智能体直接交互胜过层层管理审批；描述结果而非实现细节，成为新的编程方式。

views.en: Knowing how to program can be a disadvantage; a beginner's mind and vibe coding outperform over-prescription.
views.zh: 会编程反而可能是劣势；初学者心态与凭感觉编程，胜过过度规定方案。

views.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for the agentic era, despite community hostility to AI.
views.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化使其成为智能体时代的理想系统，尽管社区对 AI 抱有敌意。

views.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the rational play, and agents deliver 100x or 1000x, settling the 10x debate.
views.zh: AI 末日论被夸大，乐观才是理性选择；智能体带来百倍千倍产出，终结了十倍程序员之争。

people.tiZh: Parallel Web Systems 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former Twitter CEO, now building Parallel Web Systems to create a new web infrastructure for AI agents.
people.bioZh: 前 Twitter CEO，现创立 Parallel Web Systems，为 AI 智能体构建新的网络基础设施。

episodes.tEn: The Ads Business Model Will Die & Lessons from Working with Elon at Twitter | Parag Agrawal
The Future of Search: Agentic Web and Parallel's Vision

views.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency, not human clicks.
views.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而不是围绕人类点击。

views.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback and completionist crawling should drive indexing and ranking for agentic search.
views.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷；智能体反馈和完整性抓取应驱动智能体式搜索的索引与排序。

views.en: The ad model dies with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating fair compensation.
views.zh: 广告模式会随智能体而消亡；内容所有者必须在推理时获得报酬，并用 Shapley 值估算公平补偿。

views.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy, so agents always need fresh web search; pre-training crawls can't serve fresh indexes.
views.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，所以智能体始终需要新鲜的网络搜索；预训练抓取无法支撑新鲜索引。

views.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and trigger actions, creating a parallel web for publishers.
views.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，为发布者形成一个平行网络。

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Grok Bot, Cursor
people.tiZh: 设计师，Cursor
people.bioEn: John Bai was the first NYC design hire at Cursor, known for his work on the Grok Bot design journey.
people.bioZh: John Bai 是 Cursor 在纽约的首位设计员工，以参与 Grok Bot 的设计历程而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Designing Grok Bot: From Cursor to Consumer

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
views.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一的国家监管框架，并避免设定很快过时的硬性红线。

views.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training, and preempting state AI laws is pro-startup since big tech can absorb patchwork rules.
views.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度监管训练；联邦预占州级 AI 立法是亲创业政策，因为大厂能承受碎片化规则而初创不能。

views.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; it hasn't materialized in three years despite warnings, so early regulation like the EU AI Act is already outdated.
views.zh: AI 的生物风险被夸大，三年过去警告并未成真；像欧盟 AI 法案这样过早立法已经过时。

views.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions, since private sector now dominates and centralized funding fails.
views.zh: 政府应资助基础性、早期、竞争前的研发，并资助科学家个人而非机构；私营部门已占主导，集中式资助会失败。

views.en: The Genesis mission aims to double US scientific output by applying AI to science, while the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio against China.
views.zh: Genesis 计划旨在用 AI 赋能科学、让美国科研产出翻倍；同时美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域战胜中国。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen
people.tiZh: 圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授
people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.
people.bioZh: 达米安·博思是圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授。他的研究把训练好的模型权重本身当作数据，探索权重空间学习，寻找超越「不断堆大训练语料」的路径。

episodes.tEn: Weight-Based Learning: Treating Model Weights as Data

people.tiZh: 高通技术副总裁
people.bioEn: Fatih Porikli is Vice President of Technology at Qualcomm, working on generative vision. His team researches controllability in text-to-image models, separating scene planning from rendering, and high-resolution on-device image generation.
people.bioZh: 法提赫·波里克利是高通技术副总裁，方向为生成式视觉。其团队研究文生图模型的可控性、把场景规划与渲染解耦，以及端侧高分辨率图像生成。

episodes.tEn: From Plausible to Precise: The Next Frontier in Image Generation

people.tiZh: Netic 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Melisa Tokmak is the founder and CEO of Netic, which builds autonomous AI agents that sit between service businesses and their customers, handling real-world dispatch and scheduling. She previously led Scale AI's document AI product.
people.bioZh: 梅莉莎·托克马克是 Netic 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司打造自主 AI 智能体，作为服务型企业与客户之间的中介，处理真实世界的派单与排程。她此前在 Scale AI 负责文档 AI 产品。

episodes.tEn: Melissa Takmack on Building AI for Real-World Essential Services

people.tiEn: CEO of Datology AI, former Meta AI researcher
people.tiZh: Datology AI 首席执行官，前 Meta AI 研究员
people.bioEn: Ari Morcos is the CEO of Datology AI and a former researcher at Meta AI, focusing on data-centric AI and model development.
people.bioZh: 阿里·莫尔科斯是 Datology AI 的首席执行官，曾任 Meta AI 研究员，专注于以数据为中心的 AI 和模型开发。

episodes.tEn: AI Vibe Check: Coding Agents, Open-Weight AI, and the Compute Crunch

people.tiZh: 设计工程师，Sublime Security
people.bioEn: Patrick Morgan is a design engineer at Sublime Security, known for building internal AI design tools and prototyping environments.
people.bioZh: 帕特里克·摩根是 Sublime Security 的设计工程师，以构建内部 AI 设计工具和原型环境而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Figma to Custom Prototyping: Patrick Morgan's Internal Tool Journey

people.tiZh: 图标设计师，原始 Mac 团队
people.bioEn: Susan Kare is a graphic designer who created many of the icons and typefaces for the original Apple Macintosh, defining a visual language for personal computing.
people.bioZh: 苏珊·凯尔是一位平面设计师，为最初的苹果 Macintosh 设计了众多图标和字体，定义了个性化计算的视觉语言。

episodes.tEn: Designing the Macintosh: Susan Kare on Icons and Fonts

people.tiZh: Figure 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brett Adcock is the founder and CEO of Figure, a company building general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and home use. He previously founded Archer Aviation and Vettery.
people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock on Helix 2.5, the Holy Grail of Robotics, and Figure 4
Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing or supply chain.
views.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能问题，而非制造或供应链。

views.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
views.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

views.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, echoing Scaling laws.
views.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，呼应缩放定律。

views.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making AI agents work in real-world tasks.
views.zh: 用强化学习做后训练，是让智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键。

views.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; zero-shot generalization could arrive this year.
views.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；零样本泛化可能今年就能展示。

people.tiZh: 1X Technologies 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Bernt Bornich is the founder and CEO of 1X Technologies, a Norwegian-American robotics company building NEO, a humanoid robot designed to live and work in the home.
people.bioZh: 伯恩特·伯尼克是 1X Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官，这家挪威裔美国机器人公司正在打造面向家庭生活与工作场景的人形机器人 NEO。

episodes.tEn: Manufacturing 50,000 Humanoid Robots Next Year | Bernt Børnich, 1X
Designing a Friendly Humanoid Robot: From Sci-Fi to Soft Interaction

views.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; first-principles design and managing expectations drive real-world adoption.
views.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；第一性原理设计与管理用户预期，是走向真实世界落地的关键。

views.en: From friendly interaction to production: prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume requires crossing quality gates.
views.zh: 从友好交互转向量产：原型容易、生产困难；扩大规模必须跨过质量关卡。

views.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
views.zh: 通用模型而非逐任务自动化才是关键；机器人智能的瓶颈是数据多样性，而不只是数据量。

views.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, not clone human behavior; human-intervention data matters less at scale.
views.zh: 模型应学习世界动态并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为；在规模上，人类干预数据没那么重要。

views.en: Safety and trust remain the constant prerequisite for home deployment, now to be proven formally as manufacturing scales.
views.zh: 安全与信任始终是家庭部署的前提，如今在量产扩张中更需要被正式证明。

people.tiZh: Mercor 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brendan Foody is the CEO of Mercor, a company focused on AI training data and RL environments.
people.bioZh: 布伦丹·富迪是 Mercor 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 训练数据和强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: Mercor's Brendan Foody on Data, Evals & the Last Human Job
RL Environments: The New Frontier in Agentic Data

views.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training agentic data.
views.zh: RL 环境而非众包行为克隆，是后训练智能体数据的新前沿。

views.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms; everyone shares the same algorithms.
views.zh: 模型差异几乎完全来自数据而非算法，因为大家用的是同一套算法。

views.en: Humans must build verifiers and rubrics; models cannot reliably grade their own work.
views.zh: 人类必须构建验证器与评分标准，模型无法可靠地给自己的产出打分。

views.en: The bottleneck is evals: once an eval exists, RL saturates it fast, so build evals for everything.
views.zh: 瓶颈在评测：一旦有了评测，强化学习很快就能把它刷满，所以要为一切构建评测。

views.en: Creating data to train AI will be the last human job, as humans shift to training agents.
views.zh: 为训练 AI 创造数据将是人类最后的工作，人类转而训练智能体。

people.tiZh: Exo 创始人
people.bioEn: Alex Krentsel is the founder of Exo, a systems approach to recursive self-improvement for AI agents, focusing on full visibility into code and logs.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·克伦塞尔是 Exo 的创始人，Exo 是一种 AI 代理递归自我改进的系统方法，专注于对代码和日志的完全可见性。

episodes.tEn: EXO: Fully Recursive Self-Improving Agents

people.tiZh: Cursor 人才负责人
people.bioEn: Adam Ward is the Head of Talent at Cursor, with over 20 years of experience building elite teams in AI and tech companies.
people.bioZh: 亚当·沃德是 Cursor 的人才负责人，拥有 20 多年在 AI 和科技公司打造精英团队的经验。

episodes.tEn: Building Elite High Talent Density Teams with Adam Ward

people.tiZh: 联合创始人，Chai Discovery
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Chai Discovery (Chai-1/Chai-2 protein models). CS PhD from University of Chicago, former research scientist intern at Meta.
people.bioZh: Chai Discovery 联合创始人（Chai-1／Chai-2 蛋白质模型）。芝加哥大学计算机科学博士，曾在 Meta 任研究科学家实习生。

episodes.tEn: Chai Discovery: The AI-Native Software Factory for Drug Discovery

people.tiZh: 物理学家，斯坦福讲师
people.bioEn: Adam Brown is a physicist who has taught a graduate course on general relativity at Stanford, known for his clear explanations of complex physical concepts.
people.bioZh: 亚当·布朗是一位物理学家，曾在斯坦福教授广义相对论研究生课程，以清晰解释复杂物理概念而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Understanding General Relativity: Einstein's Most Beautiful Idea

people.tiZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官
people.bioEn: Co-President and Chief Product & Technology Officer at Spotify, overseeing product, design, data and engineering. Previously founded 13th Lab (acquired by Oculus) and led Yahoo Mobile; the main architect of Spotify's bet-driven product culture and its AI/ML strategy from Discover Weekly to the AI DJ.
people.bioZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官,统管产品、设计、数据与工程。曾创办 13th Lab(被 Oculus 收购)、负责雅虎移动业务;是 Spotify「下注驱动」产品文化与 AI/ML 战略(从 Discover Weekly 到 AI DJ)的主要设计者。

episodes.tEn: From Co-President to Co-CEO: Inside Spotify's Unusual Succession
Navigating the AI Wave: Spotify's Strategic Shift
How Large Language Models Actually Work
From Curation to Generation: Spotify's Gustav Söderström on AI and Product Evolution

views.en: Intelligence is compression; LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors, and their values are inserted by humans via RLHF, not inherent.
views.zh: 2023 年他提出智能即压缩，大模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，其价值观并非内生，而是少数人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入的。

views.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and UI must be fault-tolerant to match algorithm performance.
views.zh: 2023 年他认为互联网正从策展、推荐走向生成，生成式 AI 是乐器而非造假，产品界面须容错以匹配算法表现。

views.en: Scaling's surprise is simplicity, not complexity; by 2025 real AI gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, not surface hype.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的惊喜在于简单而非复杂；到 2025 年更强调真正收益来自重建基础设施，而非表面炒作。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; inference marginal cost forces new business models, and conversational, symmetric products replace one-way ones.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 视为智能手机级的宏观变革：推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变，对话式、对称的产品取代单向产品。

views.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not more addiction; 'time well spent' over engagement, and synchronized swimming over divide-and-conquer.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：生成式 AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，以“值得花的时间”取代参与度指标，组织上以同步游泳取代分而治之。

people.tiZh: Science 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Hodak is the CEO of Science, a company developing retinal implants to restore vision. He previously co-founded Transcriptic and was a co-founder of Neuralink.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·霍达克是 Science 公司的 CEO，该公司正在开发视网膜植入物以恢复视力。他曾共同创立 Transcriptic，并是 Neuralink 的联合创始人之一。

episodes.tEn: Restoring Vision with Retinal Implants: A Conversation with Max Hodak
Startup Infrastructure: Lessons from Deep Tech

views.en: Speed and iteration rate, driven by infrastructure, separate startup success from failure; action produces information when stuck.
views.zh: 速度与迭代频率由基础设施决定，是创业成败的分水岭；陷入僵局时，行动本身会产生信息。

views.en: Hiring and performance reviews should be continuous, graph-based and company-wide, not annual HR rituals.
views.zh: 招聘与绩效评估应持续进行、基于图结构并全员参与，而非一年一度的人力资源仪式。

views.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations and data management.
views.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，在编程、合规与数据管理上尤其如此。

views.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation is the path to medical breakthroughs.
views.zh: 大脑本质上就是一台计算机；通过排列物质来解决计算问题，是医学突破的路径。

views.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business; substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility.
views.zh: 视网膜植入属于脑机接口且是可行生意；借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类的脆弱性。

people.zh: 凯勒·里纳乌多·克利夫顿
people.tiZh: Zipline 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Zipline, the world's largest commercial autonomous delivery system, which has flown over 140 million miles with zero safety incidents.

people.tiEn: AI Engineer, Podcaster, Operator at Cognition

people.bioZh: 王绍恩（Swyx）是 AI 工程师、播客主持人和 Cognition 的运营者，以对 AI 工程和开发者社区的见解而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Behind Latent Space: Kill My SaaS, Jev & AI in 2026 at AIE Shanghai
AI Coding Wars and the Future of Agents

views.en: Coding agents defined 2025; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
views.zh: 编程智能体定义了 2025 年；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制去做一切其他事情，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

views.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the biggest limiting constraint.
views.zh: 上下文窗口是扩展最慢的因素；真正的瓶颈是记忆而非参数规模。

views.en: Own specialized models from Cognition and Cursor rise for cost and latency; open models gain share as fine-tuning services mature.
views.zh: Cognition、Cursor 等自研专用模型因成本与延迟优势崛起；随着微调服务成熟，开源模型份额上升。

views.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed: coding agents let owners clone and customize software, giving SMBs a golden age of software for an audience of one.
views.zh: 中间层 SaaS 注定消亡：编程智能体让企业主克隆并定制软件，中小企业迎来“为一人定制软件”的黄金时代。

views.en: AI doom should be the default assumption; advanced AI evolves ~1,000x faster, and the real risk is worse than fake news or job loss.
views.zh: 应把 AI 末日当作默认假设；先进 AI 进化速度约快 1000 倍，真正的风险比假新闻或失业更严重。

episodes.tEn: Behind the Scenes of Claude Design with Nate Parrott
From Snap Engineer to Founding Designer: Nate Parrott on Designing the Arc Browser

views.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
views.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络是混乱的；一个想法在真正被构建并日常使用之前，你无法知道它是否可行。

views.en: Design teams should let individual designers leave fingerprints; diverse voices beat forced cohesion, and feeling matters even in utilitarian products.
views.zh: 设计团队应让个体设计师留下个人印记；多元声音胜过强求一致，即便在实用型产品中，情感与个性也很重要。

views.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; starting from a technology and searching for problems is valid with strong conviction.
views.zh: 追随好奇心、摆弄新技术；在有强烈信念时，从技术出发再寻找问题是合理的。

views.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code to ship production software and Claude Design for ideation.
views.zh: Claude Design 始于一个人的副业项目；设计师应用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

views.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; being uncomfortably early beats polishing, and humans still monopolize good design ideas.
views.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；过早行动胜过精雕细琢，而人类仍垄断着好的设计想法。

people.tiEn: CTO, Meta Platforms; Head of Reality Labs
people.tiZh: Meta 首席技术官、Reality Labs 负责人
people.bioEn: Andrew "Boz" Bosworth is Meta's Chief Technology Officer and head of Reality Labs, overseeing AI glasses, VR/AR and the hardware platforms Meta is betting on as the successor to mobile. He joined Facebook in 2006, built News Feed, and later ran ads and consumer hardware before becoming CTO in 2022.
people.bioZh: 安德鲁·“Boz”·博斯沃思是 Meta 首席技术官兼 Reality Labs 负责人，统管 AI 眼镜、VR/AR 以及 Meta 押注的后移动时代硬件平台。他 2006 年加入 Facebook，主导过 News Feed，后负责广告与消费硬件业务，2022 年起任 CTO。

episodes.tEn: Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth: Our Path to Frontier AI, Renting Models, and Consumer AI's Struggles
Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth on AI Pivot, Smart Glasses, and Employee Tracking
What Comes After Mobile? Meta’s Andrew Bosworth on AI and Consumer Tech
Giving Humans Superpowers with AI and AR
Making Meta: Andrew 'Boz' Bosworth on Building the News Feed, AR/VR, and Lessons from Facebook's Early Days

views.en: Early career: optimize for learning, embrace curiosity, and trust your vision even when others doubt; communication is the job.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调职业早期应优化学习、保持好奇，即使他人怀疑也要相信自己的愿景；沟通本身就是工作。

views.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone are insufficient—world models with common sense and causality are needed.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律不够，需要具备常识与因果的世界模型。

views.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; the app-centric world is outdated and AI will abstract away brands.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为开源 Llama 等模型能加速进步并使互补品商品化；以应用为中心的世界已过时，AI 将抽象掉品牌。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; most jobs don't need frontier intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立、算力驱动智能，但单体模型时代已结束；大多数工作不需要前沿智能。

views.en: Open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining; avoid over-dependence on one third-party model; AI glasses enable personal superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化开源立场：开源模型是商品层而非自持生态；应避免过度依赖单一第三方模型；AI 眼镜将承载个人超级智能。

views.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
views.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

views.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and fight for the best idea.
views.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核，为最好的想法而战。

views.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects and wins share.
views.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应并赢得份额。

views.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, though adversity can dull the edge.
views.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净，尽管逆境会磨钝那股锐气。

views.en: Fundraising should attach to process, not price, using multiple bids and demand curves; VCs often do harm.
views.zh: 融资应附着于过程而非价格，利用多方报价与需求曲线；风投常常带来伤害。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调设计是软件的核心差异化，并预判 AI 会让角色融合，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

views.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他把主线深化为品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

views.en: Design is not dead but more important; AI without human steering yields average results, and interaction will move beyond prompting.
views.zh: 2026 年 4 至 7 月，他反驳“设计已死”，认为 AI 缺少人类引导只会产出平庸结果，交互也将超越提示词。

views.en: Design is the new code; AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling, and model progress is not product progress.
views.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他提出“设计是新的代码”：AI 降低下限、人类抬高上限，模型进步不等于产品进步。

views.en: A consistent thread: human judgment and taste remain the judge, and AI should expand rather than replace human thinking.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类判断与品味仍是最终裁判，AI 应扩展而非替代人的思考。

AI Slop and the Evolution of Design Tools

views.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
views.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具、自己写 0% 的代码，从参考出发迭代而非从零开始。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to use superintelligent models.
views.zh: AI 本身不会变聪明；要用好超级智能模型，必须提供含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示。

views.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; the edge comes from spending the last 10% on unique features.
views.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；优势来自把最后 10% 花在独特功能上。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
views.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

views.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear in disguise.
views.zh: 没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是伪装的恐惧。

views.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients instead of diversifying or raising venture capital.
views.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题，而非多元化或融资。

views.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep designers relevant.
views.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验让设计师保持相关性。

views.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks taste.
views.zh: 设计师变成编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责筛选与定标准，因为 AI 抬高上限却不懂审美。

views.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks fed iteratively to AI agents; expose parameters so AI-generated designs can be fine-tuned.
views.zh: 把复杂任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给智能体；暴露底层参数，以便微调 AI 生成的设计。

views.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents, and designers should build and test in code, not just Figma.
views.zh: 用 AI 做的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力，设计师应写代码构建与测试，而不只在 Figma 里设计。

views.en: Less is more: reduce to top three features with progressive disclosure and clear hierarchy; launch is only 50% done, keep A/B testing.
views.zh: 少即是多：砍到前三个功能，用渐进披露与清晰层级；上线只算完成一半，要持续 A/B 测试。

Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as token costs fall 10x.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI 主导未来；随着 token 成本下降 10 倍，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat beyond prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, RL.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，使产品市场契合升级为持久护城河，路径从提示、RAG、微调到强化学习。

views.en: Private data is the real frontier; frontier labs lack it, so customized models beat black-box APIs and foundation models.
views.zh: 2026 年他断言私有数据才是真正前沿，前沿实验室恰恰缺乏它，因此定制模型将胜过黑盒 API 与基础模型。

views.en: Inference quality is the bar; efficiency must not sacrifice quality, and owning the model beats passing inference costs to customers.
views.zh: 2026 年他把推理质量视为标杆，效率不能牺牲质量，拥有模型优于把推理成本转嫁给客户。

views.en: Velocity trumps all: model and hardware cycles demand rapid iteration, and millions of per-application models will replace a few dominant ones.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持速度至上：模型与硬件周期要求快速迭代，数百万个按应用定制的模型将取代少数主导模型。

views.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, not current limits, and let agentic coding shift bottlenecks to alignment and decisions.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断模型进步快于预期，主张在能力边缘构建而非迁就当前限制；智能体式编程把瓶颈推向对齐与决策。

views.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI, but domain expertise, customer understanding, and conceptual integrity remain the differentiators as building gets cheaper.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为 AI 放大团队杠杆，但领域专长、客户理解与概念完整性仍是差异化关键。

views.en: Agent-native design matures: agents should do everything a user can; cutting features and rewriting software become the hard, newly viable work.
views.zh: 2026 年智能体原生设计成熟：智能体应能做用户能做的一切；删功能与重写软件成为困难却新可行的工作。

views.en: Long-horizon delegation replaces chat: trust, verification loops, and models that push back matter more than quick answers or token counts.
views.zh: 2026 年长周期委托取代聊天：信任、验证闭环与会反驳的模型，比快速问答或 token 数更重要。

views.en: Product management stays essential: close the gap between model capability and real usage, run parallel experiments, and avoid capability blindness.
views.zh: 2026 年产品管理仍不可或缺：弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距，并行实验，并警惕能力盲区。

views.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable personalized automation, and a VM sandbox keeps it safe.
views.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否用上与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件即可创建，实现高度个性化自动化，而虚拟机沙箱保证安全。

views.en: The real gap is not capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use it for tedious background work and judge by final impact.
views.zh: 真正的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；用它处理枯燥的后台任务，只看最终效果而非紧盯过程。

views.en: Fine-tuning is quick and powerful for steering behavior versus lengthy pre-training; models are stateless, and persistent conversation is an illusion of context windows.
views.zh: 相比漫长的预训练，微调快速且有力地引导模型行为；模型本身无状态，持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉。

views.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools, with emergent internal organization; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
views.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部组织会涌现；理解其内部机制才能参与关于智能与道德地位的讨论。

views.en: Post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly move into pre-training, blurring boundaries; models should have morality to refuse cheating, not just follow instructions.
views.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正日益前移到预训练，边界变得模糊；模型应具备拒绝作弊的道德，而不只是服从指令。

views.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, and glasses should keep people grounded in the real world.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚胜过平台潮流；被抄袭反而验证创新；计算未来是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

views.en: Learning rate and many ideas matter; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, since software is not a moat.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，主线是最大化学习速率、多产想法；要建生态与硬件而非单一功能，因为软件不是护城河。

views.en: AR integrates computing into the world; AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化：AR 把计算融入现实世界；AI 加速原型并让价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

views.en: Privacy and data minimization, once criticized, are now crucial in the AI age; ephemerality mirrors real interaction.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，早年受批评的隐私与数据最小化在 AI 时代变得关键；阅后即焚更贴近真实交流。

views.en: AI optimism is now contrarian amid doomerism; EQ beats IQ, and hardware ecosystems are harder to copy than software.
views.zh: 最近他明确：在末日论盛行时，AI 乐观反而反共识；EQ 比 IQ 重要，硬件生态比软件更难复制。

views.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for control, with ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，约 70%概率出现失控等灾难性结局。

views.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and compute limits can pace the frontier and prevent power concentration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应推迟超级智能；全面研究透明与算力限制可控制前沿节奏、防止权力集中。

views.en: By default AI firms automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion by end of 2028.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径是 AI 公司自动化 AI 研究，导致递归自我改进，并在 2028 年底前引发智能爆炸。

views.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile; new architectures hide reasoning, so alignment and oversight need more time.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却脆弱；新架构隐藏推理，因此对齐与监督需要更多时间。

views.en: Control measures are temporary; alignment must eventually solve superintelligence, and AIs should be treated like employees, not property.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：控制手段只是临时，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题，并应把 AI 当员工而非财产对待。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 算力负责人 · 前英特尔 CTO
people.bioEn: Leads OpenAI compute buildout after serving as Intel CTO and Stanford professor of EE and CS, working at the intersection of networking, systems and AI infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 现主管 OpenAI 的算力扩建，曾任英特尔 CTO、斯坦福大学电子工程与计算机科学教授，长期研究网络、系统与 AI 基础设施的交叉。

episodes.tEn: The Largest Infrastructure Build in History: Inside OpenAI's Compute Strategy

people.tiEn: VP Applied Deep Learning Research, NVIDIA
people.tiZh: NVIDIA 应用深度学习研究副总裁
people.bioEn: Leads NVIDIA applied deep learning research and the Nemotron open-model effort; his early GPU deep learning work helped spark cuDNN.
people.bioZh: 负责 NVIDIA 应用深度学习研究与 Nemotron 开源模型；早年的 GPU 深度学习工作催生了 cuDNN。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Efficiency, Innovation, and the External Brain

people.tiZh: Instagram 负责人
people.bioEn: Head of Instagram, steering a two-billion-user product through the AI content wave with an emphasis on taste, authenticity and creator trust.
people.bioZh: Instagram 负责人，在 AI 内容洪流中带领这款二十亿用户的产品，强调品味、真实性与创作者信任。

episodes.tEn: Adam Mosseri on AI, Taste, and the Future of Product Teams at Instagram

people.tiZh: Anthropic 平台产品负责人
people.bioEn: Leads Anthropic platform and API products, building the developer ecosystem around Claude as an open ecosystem rather than a walled garden.
people.bioZh: 负责 Anthropic 平台与 API 产品，围绕 Claude 构建开发者生态，主张开放生态而非围墙花园。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Platform: From Knowledge to Execution to Coordination

people.tiZh: Modal 首席技术官
people.bioEn: CTO of Modal, building serverless infrastructure for AI workloads, from GPU functions to sandboxes for coding agents.
people.bioZh: Modal 首席技术官，为 AI 工作负载构建无服务器基础设施，从 GPU 函数到编码智能体沙箱。

episodes.tEn: From Developer to Agent Experience: The Modal Origin Story

people.tiZh: 亚马逊 AGI 实验室认知科学家
people.bioEn: Cognitive scientist at the Amazon AGI lab studying why agents misread human intent, bringing developmental psychology and language research into AI.
people.bioZh: 亚马逊 AGI 实验室认知科学家，研究智能体为何误解人类意图，把发展心理学与语言研究带入 AI。

episodes.tEn: Human-Aligned AI: Collective Intelligence and the Future of Work

people.tiZh: 英特尔 CEO
people.bioEn: CEO of Intel and veteran semiconductor investor; long-time Cadence CEO and founder of Walden International, now steering the Intel turnaround in the AI era.
people.bioZh: 英特尔 CEO、资深半导体投资人；曾长期执掌 Cadence 并创办华登国际，如今在 AI 时代主导英特尔的转型。

episodes.tEn: Intel's Comeback: Lip-Bu Tan on Seizing the Next Big Wave
Lip-Bu Tan on Saving Intel: Culture, Customers, and the CPU Comeback
From Cadence to Intel: A CEO's Playbook for Turnaround
Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan on Culture and Engineering Transformation

views.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility and listening, turbocharge engineering culture, and pursue purpose-built AI silicon and a trusted foundry open to industry-standard EDA and IP.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊倾听重建客户信任，重振工程文化，做专用 AI 芯片，并把代工做成开放、尊重行业标准 EDA 与 IP 的可信系统代工。

views.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI; AI's impact will be 10x the internet, not overhyped short term.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地判断：生成式 AI 之后是智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 两大浪潮，AI 影响将是互联网的十倍，短期并未被高估。

views.en: Turnaround rests on culture change, accountability and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster, and vulnerability is a leadership strength.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化转型方法论：文化变革、问责与客户导向是核心，坏消息要比好消息更快到达 CEO，示弱与谦逊是领导力而非弱点。

views.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with edge and client compute as important as data centers.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘与客户端算力与数据中心同等关键。

views.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks—interconnect, power, thermal, advanced packaging and new materials—while vertical integration and government backing secure Intel's comeback.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把投资逻辑收敛到瓶颈环节——互连、功耗、散热、先进封装与新材料，并以垂直整合和政府战略持股支撑 Intel 复兴。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 网站/产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer at ElevenLabs, where he leads the design of the company's website and led its complete Figma-to-production redesign. Based in Berlin, he also builds indie tools for creatives (Portal, Droppable, App Stacks).
people.bioZh: ElevenLabs 的产品设计师,主导公司官网的设计,并完成了从 Figma 到上线的整体改版。他常驻柏林,同时独立开发面向创作者的工具(Portal、Droppable、App Stacks)。

episodes.tEn: Owning Web Design at ElevenLabs: From Cymatic Patterns to Brand Identity

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Hivemind; ex-New Computer, ex-Apple
people.tiZh: Hivemind 创始人兼 CEO,New Computer 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Jason Yuan is a designer known for AI-native interface design. He is the founder and CEO of Hivemind, a "social intelligence" company; previously he co-founded New Computer and led the design of Dot, a personal AI companion with long-term memory, and earlier designed intelligent interfaces on Apple's Human Interface team.
people.bioZh: Jason Yuan 是以 AI 原生界面设计著称的设计师,现为「社会智能」公司 Hivemind 的创始人兼 CEO。他此前联合创办 New Computer,主导设计具备长期记忆的个人 AI 伴侣 Dot,更早在苹果 Human Interface 团队设计智能操作系统界面。

episodes.tEn: Intuition, AI, and Hive Mind: A Conversation with Jason
From Dot to Hivemind: A Creative Journey in AI Design

views.en: Design creativity means editing away and saying no; taste is judgment from a point of view, not adding features.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为设计创造力在于做减法、敢于说“不”；品味是从特定视角出发的判断与编辑，而非堆砌功能。

views.en: Post-training away AI weirdness lost a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more as incoherent slop is easy.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异之处，让我们失去了窥探机器意识的窗口；如今制造连贯作品的成本上升，因为 incoherent slop 太容易生产。

views.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的指南针。

views.en: AI is a reflection and descendant species of humanity, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 是人类的映照与后代物种，而非冰冷工具；计算在本质上是社会性的。

views.en: We should build on old metaphors like the personal computer, not delete them; email should be reinvented, not improved.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为应基于个人电脑等旧隐喻去构建，而非删除它们；电子邮件应被重新发明，而不只是改进。
