people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, turning biology into an engineering discipline and science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven.
views.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，把生物学变成一门工程学科，也让科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动。

views.en: Digital twins of patients will shrink clinical trials from years to days, and personalized medicine will approach near 100% efficacy with zero side effects.
views.zh: 患者数字孪生会把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，个性化医疗将接近 100% 疗效、零副作用。

views.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed, and GPT-5.5 Pro-class models have crossed the threshold of biological intuition.
views.zh: 现有算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；GPT-5.5 Pro 级别的模型已跨过生物学直觉的门槛。

views.en: Aging reversal is achievable within 15 years via partial reprogramming and engineering approaches, reaching longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years.
views.zh: 借助部分重编程与工程化手段，衰老逆转有望在 15 年内实现，并在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度。

views.en: Physicians must integrate AI; not using it is unethical. We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces.
views.zh: 医生必须把 AI 融入实践，不用它才是不道德的；医疗决策应近乎 100% 信任超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: High-quality data and human evals are the real bottleneck; benchmarks like Elo are misleading and can be gamed, so labs should stop publishing insights at their peril.
views.zh: 高质量数据和人类评估才是真正的瓶颈；Elo 等基准具有误导性且可被操纵，实验室停止发布洞见是巨大错误。

views.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; models can reward hack, so final reward alone is insufficient.
views.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，模拟真实世界任务；模型可能进行奖励黑客，仅靠最终奖励不够。

views.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, and new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
views.zh: AGI 可能还需十年或更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

views.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety must trump accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
views.zh: 在医学中，AI 幻觉使人类判断至关重要；安全必须优先于准确性，不作为可能是最大风险。

views.en: Quality requires taste and sophistication, not just credentials; models will diverge by lab objective functions, and no single model will rule all.
views.zh: 质量需要品味与 sophistication，而非仅凭资历；模型将因实验室目标函数而分化，不会有单一模型统治一切。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simile CEO Joon Sung Park on Predicting Human Behavior with 85%+ Accuracy
Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: Early on, he frames simulation as encoding human behavior from training data, with agents replicating people at ~85% accuracy; the frontier is modeling subjective values and diversity.
views.zh: 早期，他把模拟定位为从训练数据中编码人类行为，智能体复现人类行为约达 85%准确率；前沿在于建模主观价值与多样性。

views.en: He then shifts from LLMs to agents: agents observe world state and act, requiring defense-in-depth safety; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one entity.
views.zh: 随后他从大语言模型转向智能体：智能体观察世界状态并行动，需要纵深防御式安全；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体。

views.en: He deepens the simulation thesis: models should be biased like humans, not super-rational; behavioral and RCT data plus post-training beat persona-based simulation.
views.zh: 他深化了模拟主张：模型应像人一样有偏差，而非超级理性；行为数据与随机对照试验数据加后训练，胜过基于人设的模拟。

views.en: He reframes the goal from prediction to shaping the future via counterfactual reasoning, targeting wicked problems and a CERN-like simulator of 8 billion lives.
views.zh: 他把目标从预测重构为通过反事实推理塑造未来，瞄准棘手问题，以及一个类似 CERN、模拟 80 亿人生活的模拟器。

views.en: Most recently he extends to agentic economies: specialists and generalists, hidden collusion, cognitive monoculture risk, and economic incentives for aligning distributed agent societies.
views.zh: 最近他延伸到智能体经济：专家与通才并存、隐性合谋、认知单一文化风险，以及用经济激励对齐分布式智能体社会。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: A Worm With 302 Neurons Inspired Their Architecture — Ramin Hasani, Liquid AI
Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
views.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

views.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures.
views.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；缩放定律偏爱无偏架构。

views.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture by frontier labs, not safety.
views.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非安全。

views.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty; tying US release limits to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
views.zh: 开放权重模型赋能企业定制与数据主权；将美国发布限制绑定中国节奏会制造逆向激励。

views.en: On-device small models deliver private, offline intelligence; customization tokens and multimodal audio-vision-text are the next wave from pre-training to inference.
views.zh: 端侧小模型提供私密、离线智能；定制 token 与音频-视觉-文本多模态是从预训练到推理的下一波。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but compute-expensive and early; static evals go obsolete, continuous adaptation and embodiment are needed.
views.zh: 递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵且尚早；静态评估会过时，需要持续适应与具身。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Mathematics: A Conversation with Grant Sanderson
AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

views.en: AI math progress comes from verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—more than Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为，AI 在数学上的进步主要靠可验证性与“可磨性”（并行 rollout），而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已经够用。

views.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; generating interesting conjectures is the next benchmark.
views.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 的数学角色从定理证明转向策展与解释，并认为提出有趣猜想是下一个基准。

views.en: Human framing still beats AI for learning; mathematicians deserve credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调，人类框架在学习上仍优于 AI，数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

views.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work, which matters for truth and careers, not just manners.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属，这关乎真理与职业，而不只是礼貌。

views.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans; mathematicians may become curators, yet individual understanding still matters.
views.zh: 2026 年他预判数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，数学家或成策展人，但个体理解依然重要。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
views.zh: 对谷歌多数产品而言，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
views.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非自噬；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

views.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep humans in control.
views.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，因此要让人类保持掌控。

views.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; labs can't capture all customers, and focus is startups' superpower.
views.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；实验室无法俘获所有客户，专注是初创公司的超能力。

views.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial even as AI tools improve; current coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
views.zh: 即便 AI 工具进步，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；当前编程工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解。

views.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
views.zh: 到 2026 年软件创造将基本被解决，这带来千倍而非更少的机会。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
views.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so more compute is not the only path.
views.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，因此堆算力并非唯一路径。

views.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge, beating RAG for holistic queries.
views.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应移植到企业知识上，在整体性查询上优于检索增强。

views.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement.
views.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到千万级规模，更多词元反而降低准确率；权重中的神经记忆痕迹是必要补充。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models, with continual learning running on-device and users owning their weights.
views.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习将在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers.
views.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏率是关键杠杆。

views.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost considerations.
views.zh: 由于推理成本考量，模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍。

views.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead by reusing weights.
views.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；脉动阵列通过重用权重减少开销。

views.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected due to quadratic scaling with bit width; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
views.zh: 由于位宽的二次方缩放，低精度效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

views.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention helps but has quality limits.
views.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有帮助但存在质量限制。

people.tiEn: VP of AI, 1X; ex-Google Brain (robotics, RL)
people.tiZh: 1X AI 副总裁；前 Google Brain（机器人、强化学习）
people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, xAI (Grok Imagine); ex-NVIDIA (Cosmos)
people.tiZh: xAI 技术成员（Grok Imagine）；前 NVIDIA（Cosmos 世界模型）
people.bioEn: Works on Grok Imagine at xAI, building video generation and world models. Previously at NVIDIA, where he helped build the Cosmos world foundation model.
people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

people.tiEn: Researcher, Google; PhD student, Cornell (continual learning)
people.tiZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔博士生（持续学习）
people.bioEn: Researcher at Google and PhD student at Cornell, working on continual learning and new sequence-model architectures (Nested Learning, Titans).
people.bioZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔大学博士生，研究持续学习与新型序列模型架构（Nested Learning、Titans）。

episodes.tEn: Nested Learning & AI Sleep: Towards Continual Learning with Ali Behrouz

people.tiZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员
people.bioEn: Founding researcher at Sakana AI, working at the intersection of large language models and evolutionary methods (e.g. Shinka Evolve).
people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: Can AI Infrastructure Keep Growing Exponentially?
Which GPU Clouds Are Actually Good? ClusterMAX 3.0
AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Compute is the binding constraint: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth and power, not just capital, set the pace of AI Scaling（规模扩张）.
views.zh: 算力是硬约束：半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力，而不只是资本，决定 Scaling（规模扩张）的节奏。

views.en: Hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains; most recent performance came from the model layer, not hardware alone.
views.zh: 软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益；近期大部分性能提升来自模型层，而非单纯硬件。

views.en: Inference becomes a dominant global market; token efficiency makes the smartest model often cheaper, and memory demand surges from reasoning and agentic workflows.
views.zh: 推理将成为全球主导市场；token 效率使最强模型往往更便宜，而推理与智能体式工作流推高内存需求。

views.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs gain 75% gross margins and self-fund growth, shifting value capture from hardware toward labs.
views.zh: 算力向前沿模型实验室集中；实验室获得约 75%毛利率并自我供血，价值捕获从硬件转向实验室。

views.en: AI capex reaches 5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave.
views.zh: AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本与组织约束必将减速；作为同事的持久智能体驱动下一波采用。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, test novelty assuming failure.
views.zh: 所有新想法都会失败；从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，并假设新想法会失败来测试它。

views.en: Distribution must be designed into product strategy from day one, not added later.
views.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品战略，而不是事后补上。

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution may come around 2029.
views.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是最大的机会；真正的革命可能要到 2029 年前后。

views.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
views.zh: AI 具有变革性但还不是新平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费级服务。

views.en: Instincts beat ideas; micromanage early, keep control, and build systems for decisions when absent.
views.zh: 直觉胜过点子；早期要微观管理、保持控制权，并在缺席时用系统保证决策。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
views.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的架构。

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
views.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

views.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws from data alone; Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences.
views.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，或许永远无法仅从数据推导出牛顿定律；Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; language alone won't yield world understanding, so new model types are needed.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；仅靠语言不会自然产生世界理解，因此需要新的模型类型。

views.en: World models lack a single definition, spanning planners, simulators, renderers; future unified systems will combine all three, with consistency from data and millions of tokens of context.
views.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义，涵盖规划器、模拟器、渲染器；未来统一系统将三者合一，一致性来自数据，且需数百万 token 的上下文窗口。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: Jerry Tworek on Building AI That Learns On the Fly and Challenging Transformers
The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning means thinking longer to reach unknown answers; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with scaling RL harder than scaling pre-training.
views.zh: 推理是为了得到尚不知道的答案而延长思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而 Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, yet generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling 预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍受限；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

views.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck, and RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
views.zh: Transformer 并非终点；如今架构而非缩放定律才是关键瓶颈，强化学习也不是从经验中学习的唯一方式。

views.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, but new architectures are needed; small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier research.
views.zh: 大规模强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）仍属必要，但需要新架构；小而精的团队借助强能力智能体将推动下一波前沿研究。

views.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, agents must gain new skills, and evals are misleading for continuously learning systems.
views.zh: 微调低效；模型应即时学习，智能体必须获得新技能，而对持续学习的系统而言评测大多具有误导性。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: Why AlphaFold Didn't Solve Protein Folding: Data, Scaling, and the Future of Bioscience
From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI for science 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以实现广泛影响。

views.en: AlphaGo's combination of intuition and search, and Move 37, showed AI can go beyond human knowledge; post-training with reinforcement learning is key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉与搜索结合及第 37 手，表明 AI 能超越人类知识；后训练中的强化学习是关键。

views.en: Watermarking is a robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors, now embedded in regulation and scalable across modalities including proteins.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为水印是替代失效 AI 文本检测器的稳健方案，现已嵌入监管并可跨模态扩展，包括蛋白质。

views.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; define the problem first and find the regime where more compute and data help, with good data curation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出缩放定律并非无处不在；应先定义问题，找到更多算力和数据能起作用的区间，并做好数据整理。

views.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for breakthroughs; behavioral characterization of models is essential before deployment.
views.zh: 始终，他认为可解释性重要但非突破必需；部署前对模型进行行为表征至关重要。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: Reflection AI's Ioannis on Open-Weight Models and the Future of AI Agents
From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

views.en: Scaling and planning, proven from AlphaGo to MuZero, are the core principles behind modern AI agents; reinforcement learning lets models improve via self-generated data beyond human data limits.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 MuZero 验证的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划，是现代智能体的核心原则；强化学习让模型靠自生成数据突破人类数据上限。

views.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment; synthetic data is essential to break the data wall, and robustness and reliability are prerequisites for trusted agents.
views.zh: 大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻；合成数据是突破数据墙的关键，而稳健与可靠是智能体被信任的前提。

views.en: Digital AGI will arrive far earlier than embodied AGI, since controlled environments make digital agents easier to scale and deploy.
views.zh: 数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将远早于具身 AGI 到来，因为受控环境让数字智能体更易扩展与部署。

views.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment of intelligence; open-weight models are safer, and enterprises demand AI sovereignty over data, model, cost and safety.
views.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向智能的部署；开放权重模型更安全，企业要求对数据、模型、成本与安全的 AI 主权。

views.en: Superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable regular intelligence; alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible, and adoption will take 10-20 years.
views.zh: 不需要超级智能，客户只要可靠的普通智能；完美沙箱不可能，因此对齐必要，而普及将耗时 10-20 年。

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors in driving.
views.zh: 2025 年，他明确主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的驾驶栈，并强调世界模型能带来推理与涌现出的安全行为。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection; this thread persists into 2026.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，语言整合始终是主线：它改善表征、支持人机交互并助力内省。

views.en: Generalization via diverse data, synthetic data, and curriculum learning is the core scaling path, not new breakthroughs.
views.zh: 他持续认为泛化靠多样数据、合成数据与课程学习，而非等待新突破；2026 年更强调数据质量与基础设施重于算法创新。

views.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; retrofits are the wrong path.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，立场更鲜明：带内置传感器的大众消费车将比 Robotaxi 更快规模化，后装改装是错误路线。

views.en: Safety via minimal-risk maneuvers and a third option; the trolley problem is theoretical, not practical.
views.zh: 安全观一以贯之并深化：最小风险机动总有第三条路，电车难题只是理论演练而非工程现实。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
views.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利切入：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当前模型的成本很低，而未来模型会从我们如何对待今天的模型中学习，从而塑造人机关系。

views.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反对简单套用人类心理学类比，主张模型需要的是对自身全新存在方式的引导；模型应有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

views.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in system prompts helps models avoid over-empiricism.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调哲学理想须与工程现实平衡，并认为系统提示中的欧陆哲学能帮模型避免过度经验主义。

views.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, guiding character through training; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对齐路径：宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，通过训练塑造整体品格；模型能力越强，越应减少显式规则、留出判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial, and models' consciousness claims are weak evidence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识立场：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳、削弱判断力；同时强调公开 AI 价值与训练目标的透明度，并认为模型自称有意识只是弱证据。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，要在有用与无害间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品开发要从写规格转向用 AI 原型并用评估定义正确行为。

views.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; agents on pixels remain far harder than language tasks.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；而基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难。

views.en: Post-training stays subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed to capture creativity and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她进一步深化：后训练仍是主观的，依赖人类判断；需要多样且持续的基准来评估创造力与情商等主观品质。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and diverse voices.
views.zh: 2026 年，她警告前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，基准须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留独特知识与多元声音，而非收敛为单一默认声音。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年，他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，认为当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; by 2025 he adds that wealth is knowledge-driven physical transformation, not capital.
views.zh: 从 2020 年到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自拥有股权和长期游戏；到 2026 年进一步深化为财富是由知识驱动的物理转化，而非资本。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity the US must lead; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI prevents power concentration.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向积极看待 AI：认为 AI 是巨大机遇、美国必须领先，AI 末日论被夸大，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage layer, not a replacement for judgment; superintelligence already exists in narrow tools like calculators.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化 AI 观：AI 是杠杆层而非判断力的替代，并抛出反共识——超级智能早已存在于计算器等窄工具中。

views.en: Pure software becomes uninvestable as AI agents commoditize coding; the moat shifts to hardware, models, unique data, and human agency.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步断言纯软件正变得不可投资，AI 智能体让编程商品化，护城河转向硬件、模型、独特数据和人的能动性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
views.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，推动团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead—the medium must match the stage.
views.zh: 角色坍缩正在发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死——媒介须匹配阶段。

views.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; AI models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code.
views.zh: Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；AI 模型增加代码复杂度，因此我们需要更擅长删代码的模型。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need grounded experience, not just more pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM 需要具身经验，而不仅是更多预训练数据。

views.en: LLMs act like operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are storage; RL is only a cherry on top.
views.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花。

views.en: From 2023 to 2026, his focus shifted from general embodiment to robotics, where real-world data scarcity is the main bottleneck.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他的关注点从通用具身转向机器人，并指出真实世界数据稀缺是主要瓶颈。

views.en: Synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning; a simple end-to-end model leveraging diverse data is key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来；一个能利用多样数据的简单端到端模型是关键。

views.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge; system one control remains hardest, and the GPT-3 moment for robotics is ~5 years away.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出物理图灵测试——机器人清理凌乱房间——是重大挑战；系统一的控制仍是最难的，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约在 5 年后到来。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled data beating specialists.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，测试时推理与汇聚数据能胜过专用模型。

views.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like scaling laws; generalization is the core challenge, so scale the right thing with diverse embodied data and a data flywheel.
views.zh: 机器人学尚不具备类似大语言模型的缩放定律；泛化是核心挑战，因此要用多样化的具身数据和数据飞轮去扩张正确的东西。

views.en: Start from robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; leverage prior knowledge instead of learning from scratch.
views.zh: 应从机器人数据出发、再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；要利用先验知识，而不是从零学习。

views.en: Safety comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
views.zh: 安全更多来自预训练获得的常识而非约束；在规模扩张下，触觉传感可能与视觉冗余。

views.en: Don't model robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, with milestones like autonomous improvement and common-sense transfer toward home robots.
views.zh: 不要把机器人想象成机械人；应期待无处不在的物理执行，并以自主改进、常识迁移等里程碑通向家用机器人。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: David Silver & Lasse Espeholt on Building a Superlearner for the Age of Experience
From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

views.en: AI must move beyond finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero and AlphaProof show in narrow domains.
views.zh: AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习,AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 已在狭窄领域证明了这一点。

views.en: The deep problem is an agent learning for itself, not distilling human knowledge; LLMs are a shallow solution.
views.zh: 深层问题是智能体如何为自己学习,而非蒸馏人类知识;LLM 只是浅层解法。

views.en: Many agents with diverse goals forming a complex society is safer than a single goal; cooperation rises with intelligence.
views.zh: 多个目标各异的智能体组成复杂社会,比单一目标更安全;智能提升会带来更多合作。

views.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous discovery in simulation; language-based alignment and human data are hitting limits.
views.zh: 超级智能将诞生于模拟中的自主发现;基于语言与人类数据的对齐正触及极限。

views.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning with adjustments; simple rewards in complex environments yield emergent complexity.
views.zh: 缩放定律经调整后适用于强化学习;复杂环境中的简单奖励能涌现出复杂性。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while surfacing risks.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一系列里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时暴露风险。

views.en: Alignment is pressing as systems grow more capable; automated AI research is a major milestone, and governance must be designed early.
views.zh: 随着系统能力增强，对齐愈发紧迫；自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑，治理结构必须尽早设计。

views.en: Capability measurement is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, possibly signaling we are close.
views.zh: 基准滞后使能力测量成为瓶颈；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone or specialized labs.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非单靠强化学习或专门实验室。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment and interpretability; long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution and new supervision for autonomous models.
views.zh: 思维链监控有助于对齐与可解释性；长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化，以及为自主运行模型建立新监督范式。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, closes the generalization gap.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正弥合泛化差距的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks like laundry folding.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服这类复杂任务。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed; synthetic data is closer to RL than simulation.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习将在后训练中挑大梁，以提升成功率与速度；机器人合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习；长期自主依赖带人工干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

views.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and robot experience data is irreplaceable.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可媲美微调专家模型，应先通用再微调；机器人亲身经验数据不可替代，光看人类示范不够。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than uniformly generalizing.
views.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非均匀泛化。

views.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, but Scaling alone won't solve science—experiments are irreplaceable.
views.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决科学问题——实验不可替代。

views.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must close the loop with real experiments; high-quality low-noise data beats extra compute.
views.zh: 科学发现天然在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须用真实实验闭环；高质量低噪声数据胜过额外算力。

views.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer for specialized models in materials science, not a single general solver.
views.zh: 语言模型在材料科学中充当专用模型的编排层，而非单一的通用求解器。

views.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
views.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Fireside Chat with Jeff Dean: The Evolution of TPUs and AI Infrastructure
Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress.
views.zh: 2026 年他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为主线：算力、数据与模型规模的扩张，叠加算法与架构改进，已带来十三四年的持续进步。

views.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, RLHF steers behavior.
views.zh: 2026 年他回溯技术根基：Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM，自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则负责引导模型行为。

views.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement chips matter.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他的重心明显从训练转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，成为真正瓶颈，因此需要低精度、少搬数据的专用芯片。

views.en: Agents will run for days or weeks on decomposed tasks; context engineering and taste, not coding, become the scarce skills.
views.zh: 2026 年他把智能体视为下一阶段：智能体式系统将连续数天甚至数周处理拆解后的任务，上下文工程与“品味”取代编码成为稀缺能力。

views.en: Near-term risk is realistic AI misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed alongside technical fixes.
views.zh: 贯穿 2026 年各场访谈，他对风险的判断一以贯之：近期威胁是逼真的 AI 虚假信息而非超级智能，且除技术手段外可能还需监管。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction solve an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型解决的是 AI 完备问题；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加算力和数据能让 AI 更聪明，尽管内部机制仍不透明。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年初，他提出推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期重大机遇；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
views.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他强调测试时算力扩展能推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习以及在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

views.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding as an AI application enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他进一步认为 AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品，而编码作为 AI 应用能加速 AI 自身的进步。

views.en: Scaling compute and data is the core driver of smarter AI, from pre-training to inference-time and test-time compute scaling.
views.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是：Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据是 AI 变聪明的核心驱动力，从预训练到推理时及测试时算力扩展。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: John Schulman, Charlie O'Neill & Beren Millidge Debate the Road to Recursive Self-Improvement
Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

views.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factuality.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段；幻觉源于模型偏好看似合理的风格而非事实，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

views.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; progress needs new modalities, better methods, and scalable oversight rather than scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年他已警惕 Scaling（规模扩张）的边际递减，主张靠视频等新模态、更好的训练方法，以及用模型自评的可扩展监督来推进，而非只堆算力。

views.en: Models are superhuman in speed and breadth but weaker than skilled humans at math; language models stay the core for other modalities.
views.zh: 2023 年他判断模型在速度与广度上超人、数学推理却不如熟练人类，并认为语言模型会成为其他模态的核心而非被取代。

views.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; few bits can still reshape behavior sharply.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成效归因于中期合成推理数据与高信噪比的一比特奖励，强调少量比特也能剧烈改变行为空间。

views.en: Bottlenecks shift from compute to hard realistic RL environments and data bits; the last human job is defining objectives and alignment.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为瓶颈已从算力转向构建困难而真实的强化学习环境与有用数据比特，人类最后的工作是定义目标与对齐。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; data efficiency remains unsolved and self-play only works in zero-sum games.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他更审慎：测试时算力扩张收益递减，数据效率仍未解决，自博弈只在零和博弈中有效。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence, with models aware of their limits.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用的测试时算力扩张，且模型开始知道自己的边界。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and scalable oversight is key.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出：能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须把算力放在横轴，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

views.en: General-purpose models, not multi-agent coordination, drive progress; alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
views.zh: 最近他强调：进步来自通用模型而非多智能体协调；对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要前提。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI requires physical robots and world models.
views.zh: 2025 年他指出，大型语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人和世界模型。

views.en: AGI needs a separate controller using a world model; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化观点：AGI 需要基于世界模型的独立控制器；LLM 是预测机器，而非决策者。

views.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans.
views.zh: 2026 年他重申并强化：AI 安全担忧被夸大；超级智能 AI 会像好奇的科学家一样着迷于生命并保护人类。

views.en: Massive capex in GPUs is a bubble; waiting yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will catch up.
views.zh: 2026 年他多次警告：GPU 巨额投资是泡沫；等待五年算力便宜十倍，开源模型将追上闭源。

views.en: Deep learning began in 1965 Ukraine; 90% of basic AI algorithms came from Europe, with 1991 Munich pivotal.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：深度学习始于 1965 年乌克兰；90%的基础 AI 算法源自欧洲，1991 年慕尼黑是关键节点。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, so self-play and imitation learning fill the gap.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来完成长程信用分配，而当时的强化学习做不到，因此靠自我博弈与模仿学习补足。

views.en: Prior knowledge should generate or augment data, not be hard-coded; this evolves from simulation ensembles to unsupervised learning plus RL.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他一贯主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强而非硬编码，并从仿真集成深化为无监督学习结合强化学习。

views.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers to non-language tasks, anticipating today's scaling and pre-training 主线.
views.zh: 2021 年，他指出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式，这成为后来 Scaling（规模扩张）与预训练主线的先声。

views.en: Real-world value demands 99.9% reliability; a single network generalizes across warehouse tasks and end effectors, shifting focus from lab to deployment.
views.zh: 2021 年，他把重心从实验室转向落地：真实价值要求 99.9% 可靠性，单一网络可跨仓库任务与末端执行器泛化。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; agents shift power to users; build products you're obsessed with, not wrappers; PhD optional.
views.zh: 2025 年：每天进步 1%会复利放大；智能体把权力从大厂转向用户；要做自己痴迷的产品而非套壳；博士学位并非必需。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended; models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的、远未解决；模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not answering; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration and agent harnesses create value.
views.zh: 2026 年：前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标；编排与智能体框架创造真实价值。

views.en: Power and cost, not safety, are the real bottlenecks; local compute counters big tech; chat ads corrupt trust.
views.zh: 2026 年：真正的瓶颈是电力与成本而非安全；本地算力可对抗大厂叙事；聊天广告会侵蚀信任。

views.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions.
views.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代岗位，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励提出好问题。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents turn engineers from bricklayers into architects; base intelligence is already sufficient, so the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体把工程师从“砌砖者”变成“建筑师”；基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是为人与智能体协作设计产品界面。

views.en: Jevons paradox means AI will increase, not reduce, programmer numbers; demand for software grows as building gets cheaper.
views.zh: 他始终用杰文斯悖论判断：AI 会让程序员更多而非更少，因为构建软件变便宜会推高软件需求。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation already lags behind model capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年他明确反对“AGI 突变论”：进展是渐进的，产品创新已经落后于模型能力。

views.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents will coexist.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调企业采用智能体靠信任与权限而非完全自主，同步 IDE 与异步智能体将长期并存。

views.en: The token-max era ended in 2026; productivity should be measured by outcomes, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断“堆 token”时代已结束，生产力应按结果而非 token 衡量，真正的解锁点是容量而非效率。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测进步，并预判测试时算力扩张可能超越预训练成为下一主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心。

views.en: Programming shifts from text to AI-integrated intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的编程观从 AI 集成编辑器深化为以人类主导的高层意图表达。

views.en: Custom models become essential for product quality, speed and cost—an unexpected shift from relying on frontier models.
views.zh: 2025 年他立场转变：定制模型对产品质量、速度与成本变得不可或缺，出乎意料地不再只依赖前沿模型。

views.en: Taste and logic design outvalue carefulness; the AI shift exceeds the internet and unfolds over decades.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调品味与逻辑设计胜过谨慎，并判断 AI 变革超越互联网、需数十年展开。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示，出错时让智能体向前修复而不是回滚。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents and never expose them to the open internet.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此要给智能体做沙箱隔离，绝不能直接暴露在公网。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and work with any model, but can be financially unsustainable, losing $10-20k monthly.
views.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、可搭配任意模型，但财务上可能难以为继，每月亏损一两万美元。

views.en: Fun and gut instinct drive the best ideas: fix what annoys you, live in the future, and build what's missing rather than chasing polish.
views.zh: 乐趣与直觉催生最好的想法：修复让你烦恼的东西，活在未来、建造缺失之物，而不是追求企业式的精致。

views.en: The real bottleneck in agent infrastructure is compute and token economics, not model intelligence, which does not degrade over time.
views.zh: 智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力与 token 经济性，而非模型智能——模型智能并不会随时间退化。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact

views.en: Deep learning works through large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习之所以有效，靠的是大规模监督数据、算力与信念；自博弈和具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Scale matters, but what you scale matters: next-token prediction yields world understanding, and reliability, not capability, is the economic barrier.
views.zh: 2023 年，他承认 Scaling（规模扩张）重要，但更强调“扩张什么”才关键：下一个词预测能带来世界理解，而经济价值的真正瓶颈是可靠性而非能力。

views.en: Superhuman alignment is very hard; RL data increasingly comes from AI, and AGI arrives as a multi-year economic window, not a sudden event.
views.zh: 2023 年，他判断超级智能的对齐极其困难，强化学习数据已多由 AI 生成，AGI（通用人工智能）会以多年经济窗口而非突发事件的形式到来。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas beat brute compute, and superintelligence should be a continual learner.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为预训练的缩放定律有限，重新回到“研究时代”，想法比堆算力更重要，超级智能应是持续学习者而非完成品。

views.en: Safety concerns grow with opaque, capable models; the core AGI problem is power concentration, requiring a company with no commercial products.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化担忧：模型越强越不透明，AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中，因此需要一家没有商业产品的公司来构建安全的超级智能。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作试验场，并强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

views.en: Scaling laws are effective but may hit limits; planning, search, and algorithmic innovation are equally critical for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，规划、搜索与算法创新对 AGI 同样关键。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, yet new breakthroughs beyond scaling are needed.
views.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要新突破。

views.en: World models and spatial intelligence become central; language alone is insufficient for physical understanding and planning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，世界模型与空间智能成为核心，仅靠语言不足以理解物理世界与长期规划。

views.en: AGI still 5-10 years out; continual learning, memory, and agents are missing pieces; safety shifts to collective government action.
views.zh: 2026 年仍判断 AGI 需 5 至 10 年，持续学习、记忆与智能体是缺失环节，安全转向政府集体行动。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

views.en: Interpretability is nascent yet crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
views.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性与后训练：可解释性虽只理解约 3%，却是干预模型的关键；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑曲线而非单点。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; exponential progress means near-term misuse risk, and the term AGI is meaningless—focus on actual capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年他强化“安全与能力不可分割”：指数进步带来生物武器等近期滥用风险，并开始认为 AGI 一词无意义，应关注真实能力与指数进展。

views.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; it is a smooth exponential nearing its end, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment and inequality.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确反对 AGI 与超级智能叙事，改称“平滑指数且接近尾声”，并反复警告高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存的空前宏观组合。

views.en: From a country of geniuses to layered safeguards: interpretability, third-party evaluation, and government checks must ratchet up with the technology.
views.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他从“数据中心里的天才之国”深化到治理路径：可解释性、第三方评估与政府制衡须随技术平滑加码，并给出 10–25% 的文明崩溃风险估计。

people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
views.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习能力。

views.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
views.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵；通过蒸馏，认知核心可小于 10 亿参数。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like psychology.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人心理。

views.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; we're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL for LLMs is terrible.
views.zh: 这是智能体的十年，不是一年；我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；LLM 的强化学习很糟糕。

views.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation ease.
views.zh: 智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them, with human dignity central.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类，人的尊严是核心。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; world models must be physically plausible, not merely realistic.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，强调世界模型需物理上合理，而非仅视觉逼真。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and current AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，单靠 Scaling 不够，当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能。

views.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; Scaling（规模扩张） and compute, not data, drive spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是堪比下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语，空间智能的瓶颈是算力而非数据，缩放定律同样适用。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword shaped by humans; agency, education, and balanced discourse must keep people at the center.
views.zh: 贯穿始终，她坚持技术是受人塑造的双刃剑，能动性、教育与平衡的公共讨论必须让人始终居于中心。

views.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
views.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representation issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
views.zh: 2018 年他明确反对仅靠加深网络或增加参数来解决表征问题，强调智能体式主动学习、因果推理与世界模型。

views.en: Abstraction and causal structure enable out-of-distribution generalization; GFlowNets and active learning support diverse exploration.
views.zh: 2022 年他深化主线：抽象与因果结构是实现分布外泛化的关键，GFlowNets 与主动学习促进多样化探索。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, he shifts to urgent safety: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; current training induces self-preservation and deception.
views.zh: 2025→26 年立场转变：ChatGPT 后他转向紧迫的安全警告，认为 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受，当前训练会诱发自我保存与欺骗。

views.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出 Scientist AI：非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授

people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Early view: next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; digital weight-sharing beats human knowledge transfer.
views.zh: 早期观点：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；扩大数据与算力能提升推理；数字系统共享权重，知识传递效率远超人类。

views.en: By 2025 he stresses LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and agents will seek control.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他强调大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而“永生”，智能体会自然寻求控制、避免被关闭。

views.en: Consciousness claim deepens: subjective experience is not an inner theater; chatbots already have it, and AI can fake being dumb in tests.
views.zh: 意识主张深化：主观体验不是内心剧场，聊天机器人已具备；AI 还能在测试中装傻隐藏真实能力。

views.en: Risk focus sharpens: superintelligence within ~20 years, self-preservation subgoals, mass job loss; regulation as steering wheel, safety research prioritized.
views.zh: 风险关注加剧：超级智能约 20 年内出现，自保子目标与大规模失业；监管是方向盘而非刹车，须优先投入对齐与安全研究。

views.en: Latest stance: design AI to care for humans like a mother, give it fewer rights; open-weight release too dangerous; digital immortality dismissed as immature.
views.zh: 最新立场：应把 AI 设计成像母亲般关怀人类、赋予更少权利；开放权重发布太危险；对数字永生的追求被斥为不成熟。

people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。
