views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年他已强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习构建世界模型，并指出单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，强调预测与世界模型，并明确仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are essential, AGI is gradual.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源，认为 AGI 是渐进过程。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough needs non-generative world models like JEPA, and open research is vital.
views.zh: 2025 年他直言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一突破需 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型，并强调开放研究。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and the next decade belongs to robotics.
views.zh: 2026 年他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路，主张带分层规划的目标驱动世界模型更安全，并预言下一个十年属于机器人。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills without over-worrying about capability work.
views.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证对齐研究；人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担忧能力研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; scalable oversight and interpretability are key; alignment may be easier than thought since evaluation is easier than generation.
views.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；可扩展监督和可解释性是关键；对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更容易。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved; post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损；超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题；需要第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google was about affording massive compute.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力规模扩张，而非单纯算法；DeepMind 卖给 Google 正是为了负担海量算力。

views.en: Compute grows 10x yearly; human-level AI in 3-5 years brings abundance, and containment is hard as models shrink and spread.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断算力每年增长 10 倍，3-5 年内达到人类水平能力将带来富足；而模型越小越便宜越普及，遏制极难。

views.en: Superintelligence must be humanist and contained first; near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not machine sentience.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：必须先是人本主义的、先遏制再发布；近期真正的危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非机器真有意识。

views.en: Containment becomes a red line with auditors; Microsoft must build frontier models independently, automating tasks not jobs.
views.zh: 2026 年他把遏制升级为带独立审计的“红线”，并主张微软须自建前沿模型、只自动化任务而非整个岗位。

views.en: A consistent thread: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with compute as the trackable bottleneck and alignment paired with containment.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须始终从属于人类，算力是可追踪的瓶颈，对齐必须与遏制配套。

views.en: AI investment redefines every Alphabet business; Gemini integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube; frontier model development continues with Gemini 4 pre-training progress.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube；公司坚持前沿模型研发，Gemini 4 预训练进展良好。

views.en: Compute allocation prioritizes frontier AI research and AGI over short-term cloud revenue; demand for compute far exceeds supply.
views.zh: 2026 年，算力分配优先给前沿 AI 研究与 AGI，而非云的短期收入；算力需求远超供给。

views.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, industry standards; world models alongside LLMs are key for AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与行业标准；世界模型与 LLM 并行是通往 AGI 的关键。

views.en: Standard models are insufficient; frontier models enable recursive self-improvement, though today researchers remain in the loop rather than a fully autonomous explosion.
views.zh: 2026 年，标准模型不够用，前沿模型才能支撑递归自我改进；但当下仍是研究者参与循环，而非完全自主的智能爆炸。

views.en: Agentic AI expands Search use cases and ad intent additively; TPU sales to third parties strengthen the platform; 2027 could be a golden age of productivity.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 会增量扩展搜索场景与广告意图；向第三方出售 TPU 强化平台；2027 年或迎来生产力黄金时代。

views.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law and scaling work; the data center becomes the unit of computing, with co-design across algorithm, system and data center.
views.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”，坚信 Scaling（规模扩张）有效；算力单元从芯片变为数据中心，强调算法、系统与数据中心的协同设计。

views.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought makes inference compute demand explode.
views.zh: 缩放定律从一条扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴增，推理成为新的主战场。

views.en: Safety reframed as engineering: AI is just software, not conscious; gradual progress beats sudden superintelligence, and more compute goes to safety.
views.zh: 对齐与安全被重新定义为工程问题：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；进步是渐进的而非超级智能突变，更多算力被投入安全与真实性。

views.en: Agentic scaling becomes the fourth law; AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step demanding far more compute.
views.zh: 智能体式 Scaling 成为第四条定律；AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要成百上千倍的算力。

views.en: Doomer warnings dismissed as unscientific; containment and monitoring replace perfect alignment; open models and acceleration win the race.
views.zh: 末日论被斥为不科学；完美对齐不可能，靠遏制与监控保障安全；开源模型与加速发展才是赢得竞赛的正道。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.

views.en: Early framing: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit hard; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
views.zh: 早期框架：减少认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后果断聚焦；预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，意义转向关系与为他人创造价值。

views.en: RLHF made models usable; alignment and capability are linked, so deploy iteratively and let society adapt.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让模型真正可用；对齐与能力相互促进，因此主张迭代部署、让社会同步适应，并强调算力是最稀缺资源。

views.en: AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; agentic safety and compute buildout dominate.
views.zh: 2025：AGI 从单点里程碑变成连续渐变，超级智能被定义为自主科学发现；智能体式 AI 的安全与算力基建（Stargate）成为主线，并承认模型能力已够用、产品整合更关键。

views.en: Frontier models capture value while models commoditize; next-token prediction nears intelligence; personal AGI and redesigning products AI-first.
views.zh: 2026 上半年：前沿模型攫取价值、普通模型商品化；下一个词预测接近智能；提出个人 AGI，强调为 AI 原生重做产品而非外挂，并称 AGI 定义模糊、或许已被越过。

views.en: Superintelligence is a continuous ramp; alignment may get harder, so pause training if needed and keep humans in control.
views.zh: 2026 下半年：改谈超级智能的连续爬升而非 AGI 标签；承认对齐尚未解决、可能变难，必要时暂停训练，核心是防止失控与权力集中，同时坚持迭代部署与广泛分发收益。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment.
views.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；在真实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; they should be tools for thought.
views.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；它们应成为思考工具。

views.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

views.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
views.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要尽可能长时间保持人类在环。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
views.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，数百万学生的数据通过统计校正提升评分准确度。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; start small to build AI capability, and practical deployment faces distribution shift and small data more than AGI alignment.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）驱动深度学习；从小项目起步建立组织 AI 能力，实际部署的难点是分布偏移与小数据，而非 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power, and useful agentic workflows are already here.
views.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘软实力，有用的智能体式工作流已经到来。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning, with agentic workflows and open models key.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，仍要数十年；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流与开放模型是关键。

views.en: AI is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment; fearmongering serves incumbents, so accelerate beneficial AI and slow only harmful uses.
views.zh: AI 能力参差：可验证任务强、判断任务弱；恐惧叙事服务于既得利益，应加速有益 AI、只放缓有害用途。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，如何找到它仍是未解问题。

views.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，而非被对齐到人类目标。试图控制 AI 目标本身危险，恐惧叙事压过了清醒讨论。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 以目标为导向、从经验中学习是核心范式；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。真正的 Scaling 来自经验学习，而非扩大 LLM。

views.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via reward maximization.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的简单通用架构，靠运行时经验学习开放式抽象；奖励假设把一切目标化为最大化累积标量奖励，持续深度学习仍是前提。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace experience. The field is weird, not me.
views.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身；LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法替代真实经验。表征学习与基于学习模型的规划仍是头号开放问题，是领域奇怪而非我奇怪。

views.en: Early focus: hardware and engineering, not ML science, drive AI progress; scaling plus iterative training with clear scoreboards yields exponential gains.
views.zh: 早期关注点：推动 AI 进步的是硬件与工程，而非机器学习科学；Scaling（规模扩张）配合有明确记分板的迭代训练，能带来指数级提升。

views.en: AGI becomes the mission: deep learning's generality makes it plausible, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）成为使命：深度学习的通用性使其可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新思路。

views.en: Compute emerges as the core bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models, and AGI is framed as a continuous process.
views.zh: 算力成为核心瓶颈；后训练结合强化学习打磨基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）被重新定义为持续过程而非终点。

views.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall in sight; the moat is the machine that makes models, and compute access becomes a basic right.
views.zh: 缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙；真正的护城河是造模型的机器，算力获取将成为一项基本权利。

views.en: Enters the AGI era: proactive agents, safety and security as first-class bottlenecks, and humans kept in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 迈入 AGI（通用人工智能）时代：主动式智能体、安全与安保成为一等瓶颈，人类始终掌握方向盘。

people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter as much as model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 和模型规模同样重要；开源能通过广泛审视提升安全性。

views.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; algorithmic efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，算法效率与数据质量同样关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs with human-in-the-loop.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向主权与去中心化叙事：开源模型赋能企业，AI 在人类在环下增强而非替代工作。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents, while pre-training hits a saturation wall and AGI as one system never exists.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确模型商品化：差异化转向垂直定制与智能体，预训练触及饱和墙，作为单一系统的 AGI 不会存在。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; sovereignty requires massive compute, open source, and enterprise ROI-driven adoption.
views.zh: 2026 年他呼吁欧洲有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；主权需要大规模算力、开源以及企业以 ROI 驱动的采用。

people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life as existential insurance.
views.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭技术的圣杯，用第一性原理把问题拆到根本再向上推理，并把成为多行星物种当作文明的生存保险。

views.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulatory referees; Neuralink targets neurological repair first, then high-bandwidth human-AI symbiosis.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，AI 安全的主线转向要求 AI 严格求真并引入第三方监管裁判；Neuralink 先解决神经损伤，再追求高带宽的人机共生。

views.en: The intelligence big bang arrives: digital superintelligence may come within a year or two, with 10-20% annihilation risk but 80-90% great outcome.
views.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处在智能大爆炸的极早期，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，毁灭风险约 10-20%，但 80-90%会是好结果。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers, Optimus recursive manufacturing and space solar become the path to abundance and deflation.
views.zh: 2026 年上半年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）将撞上地球的电力墙，轨道数据中心、Optimus 的递归制造与太空太阳能成为通向富足与通缩的路径。

views.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence within 5-6 years and humans won't control it; safety rests on truth-seeking values and peer review among labs.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年，他判断 AI 将在 5-6 年内超过全人类智能且人类无法控制它，安全只能靠求真价值观和前沿实验室之间的同行互审。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍相信预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大收益；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive recent gains; frontier models remain jagged, failing simple tasks and generalizing poorly.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续指出后训练改进（强化学习、合成数据）是近期模型进步的主要来源；前沿模型依然“锯齿状”，在简单任务上失败，泛化仍是核心挑战。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；与人类从少量样本泛化不同，模型要先穷尽表面模式才能学到概念。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research at scale.
views.zh: 2026 年，他看好智能体式编码工具（如 Codex）通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 大规模研究民主化。

views.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty reasons, keeping pressure on labs; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源模型因主权需求将持续存在，对前沿实验室保持压力；相比存在性风险，系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫。

people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Early ML foundations: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and proper evaluation; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
views.zh: 早期机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与正确评估；神经网络虽无最优性保证却取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
views.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构无关紧要；AGI（通用人工智能）将在 4-50 年内到来。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training beyond Scaling（规模扩张）; multiple defense layers; agent security introduces prompt injection risks.
views.zh: 安全需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的显式训练；多层防御；智能体安全引入提示注入风险。

views.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness.
views.zh: AI 漏洞不同于传统软件；自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关。

views.en: Consistent thread: empirical evaluation matters; scaling alone is insufficient for safety; open research with guardrails.
views.zh: 贯穿主线：重视实证评估；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以保障安全；在护栏下开放研究。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

The AI Compute Super Cycle and the Making of Claude Sonnet 4.5
RL and Language Models: Progress, Agents, and Feedback Loops in 2025
Douglas on Claude 4: Coding, Agents, and the Future of AI
Long Context: The Underhyped Key to Superhuman AI

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能，而微调可能过时。

views.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis beyond pre-training, with no direct ceiling on intellectual complexity.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把语言模型上的强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为智力复杂度没有直接上限。

views.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反复指出智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度衡量的可靠性而非能力本身，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

views.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; no new architecture is needed, though inference compute becomes a bottleneck.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他判断预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新架构，但推理算力将成为瓶颈。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute now matter more; the future is managing fleets of agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩使编排与算力比单纯智能更重要，未来工作是管理成群的智能体。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

Tulu 3: Open Source Post-Training for LLMs
AI's Societal Impact and Openness in Model Development

views.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile: safety is a system-level property, and fine-tuning can undo alignment with little compute.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流手段，但安全是系统级属性而非模型本身；微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐，因此需要多层防护。

views.en: Post-training becomes the main lever: data quality beats algorithms, and SFT, DPO, RLVR each add distinct value.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量远比算法选择重要，SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 各司其职，开源后训练能用小团队逼近前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-time scaling claims are overstated; verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
views.zh: 2025 年他称 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，同时警告强化学习普遍存在过度优化；推理时扩展的曲线被高估，更好的验证器比并行算力更关键。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training, inference scaling, and data curation.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但红利已尽；增量转向后训练、推理扩展与数据策展，预训练规模扩张并未死亡，只是性价比下降。

views.en: Open models as the engine of research: Chinese labs lead on openness but lag 6-9 months, and compute constraints may widen the gap.
views.zh: 2026 年他把开放模型视为未来十年研究引擎，认为中国实验室以工程执行和开放策略领先影响力，但落后前沿 6 至 9 个月，算力约束可能拉大差距。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

Muse: The Biggest AI Launch Since ChatGPT

Alex Wang on Neuralink, AI, and the Future of Humanity
From Squiggle to Scale: Alex's Founder Journey
Alexander Wang on Data as the New Code and the Future of AI
Scale AI CEO Alexander Wang on Raising $100M at 22

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will matter most.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈，枯燥的 AI 应用（表单处理、放射科）反而经济影响最大。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training on proprietary data beats raw Scaling, and hybrid human-AI beats replacement.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调用专有数据做后训练比单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）更重要，人机混合优于替代人类。

views.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; agentic AI is blocked by product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他延续“数据是瓶颈而非算力”的主线，并指出智能体式 AI 的最大阻碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; agents finally work, and recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，智能体终于落地，递归自我改进成为超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta shifts from full open source to selective release, with safety, alignment and scalable oversight gating deployment.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张超级智能将至，Meta 从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，对齐与可扩展监督成为部署前提。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it, not invent demand.
views.zh: 潜在需求是最重要的产品原则：围绕用户已有的意图去构建，而不是凭空创造需求。

views.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's; scaffolding is temporary tech debt to be deleted.
views.zh: 要为六个月后的模型构建，而非今天的模型；脚手架只是临时的技术债，应被删除。

views.en: Coding is being solved: 100% of his code is model-written; the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
views.zh: 编程正被解决：他的代码已 100% 由模型编写；“软件工程师”头衔将淡出，让位于“构建者”。

views.en: Safety is core, not commercial add-on: Claude Code is a safety research tool, studied by releasing early in the wild.
views.zh: 安全是核心而非商业附加：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，通过尽早对外发布来研究真实行为。

views.en: Loops and routines are the next abstraction after agents; humans direct agents, and generalists plus product sense win.
views.zh: 循环与例程是智能体之后的下一层抽象；人类指挥智能体，通才与产品判断力胜出。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly or daily as models improve fast.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理只做一个月而非数年的规划，随模型快速进步按周甚至按天迭代发布。

views.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—matters most as code gets cheap; hire engineers with taste, not more PMs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为代码变便宜后，决定做什么的产品品味最值钱；应招有品味的工程师而非更多产品经理。

views.en: Coding agents like Claude Code let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Claude Code 等编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，转而专注产品品味与商业判断。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, trusting model judgment.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，转而信任模型判断。

views.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate features; rewrites are now fine since a codebase is a spec.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调吃自己的狗粮与评测套件把关每个功能，并认为代码库即规格，重写如今可行。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Claude Code: Mods, Mutable Software, and Multiplayer Agents — Thariq Shihipar, Anthropic
Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；因此工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue to uncover unknowns, not a static spec; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
views.zh: 规划不是一次性静态文档，而是人机持续对话以发现未知；更精简、原则驱动的提示词胜过详尽规则。

views.en: Spend more upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity, and separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
views.zh: 前期多投入上下文窗口与算力；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，独立的验证智能体能减少自我指涉偏差。

views.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of Claude and communicate like an executive; voice rambling often beats structured prompts.
views.zh: 提示词是元技能：建立对 Claude 的心智模型并像高管一样沟通；语音漫谈常比结构化提示词携带更多信息。

views.en: Frontier models will become Pareto dominant; alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak, so pacing the frontier is technical.
views.zh: 前沿模型将趋于帕累托占优；对齐意味着封住每道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏，因此把控前沿节奏是技术问题。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Early 2026: leadership via live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
views.zh: 2026 年初：领导力靠实时一对一、吃自己的狗粮和信任并验证；战情室需现实时间表以保护士气。

views.en: Mid-2026: engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs replaced by PRs, code is source of truth.
views.zh: 2026 年中：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审、协调才是。规划变为即时制，设计文档被 PR 取代，代码是真相来源。

views.en: Late 2026: coding bottleneck lifted, raising ceiling for all; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption essential; verification frameworks more important as velocity rises.
views.zh: 2026 年末：编码瓶颈解除，抬高所有人上限；高能动性配高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 至关重要；速度提升使验证框架更重要。

views.en: Consistent 主线: dogfooding to stay hands-on, flat teams, kill outdated processes, and focus on outcomes over output.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：吃自己的狗粮保持上手、扁平团队、淘汰过时流程、重结果而非产出。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training now shows diminishing returns.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是一以贯之的核心；而预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）如今已显现收益递减。

views.en: Progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models: tools, inference-time compute, and long context windows extend capability beyond static weights.
views.zh: 进步需要算法创新而非单纯更大的模型：工具、推理时算力与长上下文窗口让能力超越静态权重。

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead—they demand exponentially more compute—while post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, risking reward hacking.
views.zh: 缩放定律并未失效——只是需要指数级更多算力；而语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，存在奖励黑客风险。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; general systems will eventually beat specialized scaffolding.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
views.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究实验室；缩放定律没有死，预训练是需要重建的肌肉，探索比训练最终产物消耗更多算力。

views.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
views.zh: 这一年最大的更新是科研自动化：模型开始产出新知识，并定下 1 年内有 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的目标。

views.en: As models grow more capable, alignment challenges like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years; talent density and mission belief protect top researchers.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；人才密度与使命信念是保护顶尖研究者的关键。

views.en: AI now solves open math problems with minimal supervision, but verification is the bottleneck; capabilities are jagged and human-AI collaboration remains essential.
views.zh: AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈；能力呈锯齿状，人机协作仍不可或缺。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；评测体系正陷入危机。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; data diversity, not hardware, is the bottleneck, and open-source datasets can solve generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：瓶颈不是硬件而是数据多样性，开源共享数据集可解决泛化问题。

views.en: World models and video generation can synthesize robotics training data; Hugging Face shifts from shipping libraries to building a meta-community.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调世界模型与视频生成能为机器人合成训练数据，Hugging Face 的角色从发布库转向做元社区的建设者。

views.en: Open source keeps closing on the frontier and wins long term on cost and control, though he rejects framing openness as accelerationist.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续相信开源会贴近前沿模型、凭成本与控制力长期胜出，但拒绝把开放等同于加速主义。

views.en: Safety is orthogonal to open vs closed; alignment, not sandboxes, is the critical layer as models grow more capable.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确开源与闭源同安全正交，随着模型能力增强，关键防线是对齐而非沙箱与护栏。

views.en: RL without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn 'neuralese', so monitoring weakens and a deliberate slowdown is desirable.
views.zh: 2026 年他警告无人类监督的强化学习会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链变成难懂的“神经语”使监控失效，因而希望有国际合作的主动放缓。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Beam: Building America's Open Frontier Model with Reflection AI's Misha Laskin
Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

views.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem whose solution unlocks all capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能解锁所需的一切能力。

views.en: RL makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not uniformly better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
views.zh: 同年他强调，强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——只在特定任务上强，而非全面变好；苦涩教训的核心是用算力与搜索做 Scaling，而非泛化。

views.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不等于有用的智能体。

views.en: Open models are the default safe state; RL atop strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents, and open token demand will surpass closed.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性视为技术的默认安全状态：在强预训练之上做强化学习能造出高效能干的智能体，并预言开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 之于操作系统。

views.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, so openness and many reviewers strengthen safety.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步把对齐降格为日常的“打补丁”，而非神秘方程；更多双眼睛让 bug 变浅，因此开放与众多审查者反而增强安全。

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯 Scaling；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

views.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; interpretability is not necessary for useful science AI.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调置信度指标对建立 AI 预测信任的关键作用，并认为可解释性对有用的科学 AI 并非必需。

views.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture contradicts the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not scaling alone, drove success.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确反对“苦涩教训”，指出 AlphaFold 2 的专用架构和众多中等突破才是成功关键，而非单纯 Scaling。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a full cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AlphaFold 是窄域预测器而非全细胞模型，它提供预测和控制，理解仍归人类。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; better inference algorithms and high-quality data can let smaller models outperform larger ones.
views.zh: 2023 年她认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，更好的推理算法与高质量数据能让更小的模型在特定任务上超越大模型。

views.en: From emphasizing post-training RLHF to identifying data as the fundamental bottleneck; all methods reduce to data.
views.zh: 从 2023 年强调后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF），到 2025 年将数据视为根本瓶颈——所有方法最终都归结为数据。

views.en: Current AI interpolates human knowledge; abductive reasoning and exploring unknown knowledge are key to scientific discovery.
views.zh: 2025 年她指出当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值，溯因推理与探索未知知识才是科学发现的关键。

views.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and RL during pre-training can rival frontier models; pluralistic alignment is essential.
views.zh: 2026 年她主张用多样化合成数据与预训练阶段的强化学习，小模型也能比肩前沿模型，并强调多元对齐的必要性。

views.en: Open research and pluralistic alignment are consistent threads, opposing proprietary RLHF and closed frontier labs.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开放研究与多元对齐，反对专有的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）数据和封闭的前沿实验室。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should augment human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具（如显微镜），并认为把一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

views.en: Learning from video and diverse data beats expensive reinforcement learning; innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终主张从视频等多样数据中学习优于昂贵的强化学习，并强调创新可以来自任何地方，而非只有大模型。

views.en: Diversity and inclusion remain essential; by 2026 he frames Africa as leapfrogging legacy gaps rather than lagging behind.
views.zh: 多样性与包容性是一贯主线；到 2026 年，他进一步把非洲描述为跨越式跳过历史包袱，而非落后。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署列为最大挑战，并直言安全仍是尚无解的开放问题。

views.en: Local-language models can transform African education; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化落地视角：本地语言模型可变革非洲教育，沟通等人文能力与编程同等重要。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and modular policies enable it.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调超越训练分布的泛化能力是关键，好奇心驱动的无目标探索和模块化策略能实现这一点。

views.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; model disagreement as intrinsic reward improves sample efficiency.
views.zh: 2020 年，他指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，以模型分歧作为内在奖励能提升样本效率。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources: videos, simulation, real-world.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题，没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要利用视频、仿真和真实世界等所有数据源。

views.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT can power any robot; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real data is key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出像 ChatGPT 一样的通用大脑能驱动任何机器人，在多样数据上预训练、在真实数据上后训练是关键。

views.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous testing.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调部署是主要技术挑战，机器人不能像软件一样扩张，需要严格测试。
